jobs.title: Director Engineering- Internal Combustion Engine New Technology Introduction, Analysis and Simulation
jobs.description:
The Director Engineering- Internal Combustion Engine New Technology Introduction, Analysis and Simulation
will shape the future of engine technology by building a high-performing engineering organization, advancing engine technologies, and translating simulation and test insights into products that deliver measurable customer and business value.
The Director of Engineering for Internal Combustion Engine Technology leads teams that develop and mature advanced engine technologies. The role sets technical strategy across engine hardware, controls, benchmarking, cost optimization, and advanced analysis and simulation. This leader guides technologies through progressive technology readiness levels (TRL) by integrating competitive benchmarking, design, prototyping, physical testing, and model-based development. The position also establishes analysis and simulation capabilities and processes that support technology introduction and new product development. Success requires deep technical expertise in internal combustion engines, a record of building and leading high-performing engineering teams, and the ability to translate complex engineering work into clear business and product decisions. The organization combines physical testing with 1-D and 3-D simulation, CFD, FEA, in-cylinder combustion modeling, MATLAB/Simulink, Python-based analytics, machine learning, and co-simulation to improve engine performance, emissions, thermal and structural reliability, cost, and development speed to market. Working closely with business leaders and partners in service, operations, supply chain, and finance, this leader aligns technology investments with customer needs and commercial priorities. The Director also develops and implements disciplined engineering methods that deliver superior products while fostering innovation, creativity, technical excellence, and accountability across the organization.

Minimum Qualifications

Bachelor of Science Degree in Mechanical, Electrical Engineering or related degree;
15 years of progressive engineering experience related to internal combustion engines
7 years management experience

Preferred Qualifications

Master’s Degree or PhD in related field preferred but not required.
Experience in industrial/commercial products environment.
Experience with global product releases throughout the entire product life cycle desired.
Advanced experience leading engine analysis, simulation, or development teams supporting internal combustion engine and/or generator platforms.
Expertise in advanced technology engine development, prototype, and testing.
Expertise in internal combustion engine hardware, controls, and emissions.
Experience with engine and engine system simulation tools and methods, including GT-SUITE, GT-xCHEM, CHEMKIN, Converge, Ansys Fluent, MATLAB/Simulink, Python, CFD, FEA, and predictive analytics or similar industry tools.
Experience using advanced simulation insights to influence product roadmaps, power cylinder optimization, emissions strategy, thermal management, aftertreatment design, and system validation priorities.

Essential Duties

Designs and directs the work of the functional area. Selects, coaches, and develops the team, setting objectives that align with company strategy to inspire and motivate the team.
Manages organizational talent through performance management, succession planning and development.
Designs and directs processes by which team and individual performance are recognized, feedback is consistently delivered and performance is systematically improved.
Establishes the vision and strategy to drive world-class excellence within the global engines engineering team, including advanced engine analysis, simulation, modeling, and data-driven engineering capabilities that support internal combustion engine design and development.
Drives results that are specifically targeted to the industrial/commercial market and leads processes with corporate planning and new product development teams.
Creates and maintains an organizational culture which encourages innovation, collaboration, excitement/commitment and a sense of urgency toward goals, and continuous improvement.
Challenges team members to question the status quo and ensure that all aspects of the design, development, simulation, validation, and support process are optimal for the engine generator market.
Effectively manage the development process, including time compression techniques, design/application standards for improved repeatability, global process alignment, and standardized modeling workflows and analysis best practices that improve simulation efficiency and accuracy. Lead department process and best practices documentation.
Develop and lead the engine analysis and simulation portion of the product development life cycle which includes interaction from the various business segments throughout design, manufacturability, simulation, validation, and serviceability, providing customers the very best in innovation, quality, and customer satisfaction.
Lead the application of 1-D and 3-D simulation, CFD, FEA, in-cylinder combustion analysis, co-simulation, and predictive analytics to evaluate thermal, structural, fluid dynamics, combustion, emissions, reliability, and system performance requirements.
Ensure the optimal application of technology, simulation tools, data analytics, and engineering resources to meet engine product development requirements.
Work directly with cross functional teams and product management in developing an advanced technology development roadmap for engines that targets specific customer needs.
Use simulation results and modeling insights to influence technology roadmaps, emissions reduction strategies, power cylinder optimization, aftertreatment design direction, gaseous fuel system considerations, and product reliability improvements.Manage expenses to ensure regulatory compliance and support corporate goals (e.g. revenue growth, profitability, market penetration).
Lead benchmarking activity for engine technology.

Other Duties As Assigned And The Following

Foster collaboration between engineering, sales, operations, finance, and other departments to identify and harvest new engineering concepts, technologies, techniques, standards and procedures.
Engage in and lead business planning processes, recruitment, retention, talent acquisition, development, and mentoring.
Sponsor the development of standardized reporting formats and governance for analysis objectives, methods, results, and engineering recommendations.
Stay informed on relevant technologies, tools, and industry trends in internal combustion engine simulation, emissions modeling, aftertreatment, co-simulation, and predictive analytics to support continuous improvement.
Other duties as assigned.

Knowledge, Skills And Abilities

Advanced level experience in team building and leadership skills;
Demonstrated ability to deliver results while working on multiple global projects simultaneously, balancing resources, timing and quality of outcomes;
Advanced understanding of engineering technical issues/needs, financial, sales, and marketing as related to product design and development;
Deep understanding of internal combustion engine design, operation, testing, exhaust aftertreatment, thermal management, lubrication systems, crankcase ventilation, combustion phasing, turbochargers, exhaust gas recirculation, and gaseous fuel systems;
Executive-level ability to interpret, challenge, and communicate complex simulation, CFD, FEA, combustion, co-simulation, machine learning, and predictive analytics results to technical and non-technical stakeholders;
Ability to establish modeling workflows, analysis best practices, and data-driven decision-making standards that improve engineering efficiency, accuracy, and product reliability;
Excellent communication skills;
Self-driven, highly motivated, flexible and high capacity to learn;
Previous experience with managing a departmental budget.

Physical Demands

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to talk and hear; and use hands to manipulate objects or controls. The employee is regularly required to stand and walk. On occasion, the incumbent may be required to stoop, bend, or reach above the shoulders. The employee must occasionally lift up to 25 pounds. Specific conditions of this job are typical of frequent and continuous computer-based work requiring periods of sitting, close vision and ability to adjust focus. Up to 10% travel and valid Driver’s License required.

Benefits

This position includes a comprehensive benefit package that includes medical, dental and vision plans; life, long-term disability, flexible spending, and health savings accounts, accrued paid time off, 8 paid Holidays, opportunity for overtime and 401(k) retirement benefits.

Description

Job Title: Director, Embedded Software Engineering

Job Location: San Jose, CA (This position requires a full-time, on-site presence in our San Jose, CA office)

Job ID: AI2558

Description:

The SoC software team creates the Board Support Package (BSP) and platform SW for SiMa.ai's MLSoC™ product line. The team develops and supports the OS, boot software, device drivers and run-time environment for the multiple subsystems in the MLSoC, and builds embedded Linux applications and APIs that supports customers and end-to-end applications across the MLSoC's IO subsystems.

We are looking for a hands-on Director of Engineering to lead the embedded software team at our San Jose headquarters. You will own the technical direction and delivery of the US SoC SW team, coordinate feature delivery with the India team, and work closely with the other global SW teams and with silicon, hardware, validation, product and customer-facing groups.

Responsibilities:

Own the roadmap, schedule, quality and release of the MLSoC SDK features assigned to the US team: OS, boot software, device drivers, run-time environment, and embedded Linux applications and APIs. The SoC SW team also supports Factory Test for SiMa PCBAs.
Contribute hands-on to architecture, design and code review, and step in directly on critical bring-up and debug work in U-Boot, firmware, secure boot, Linux and associated interface libraries.
Set technical direction for the secure boot chain, firmware and U-Boot, including key management and image authentication.
Set technical direction for eLxr/Debian builds, and for the Linux configurations on each reference board.
Direct the development of drivers for low-speed and high-speed peripheral interfaces, and support for Docker, hypervisor and RTOS environments. This includes PCIe, MIPI, USB, DDR, Ethernet, I2C, SPI, SDIO, etc.
Work as a peer with the Director of Engineering in India to plan, split and coordinate feature delivery across both sites, and keep priorities, schedules and interfaces aligned.
Leverage AI to optimize all SW processes
Lead, hire and develop the US embedded software team
Plan headcount and budget for the US SoC team, and report progress and risks to executive leadership.
Oversee integration of third party IP software into the MLSoC software environment.
Partner with silicon and hardware teams on pre-silicon verification using SoC emulators, and on post-silicon bring-up and troubleshooting.
Provide SW for the MLSoC chip validation
Work with product management and customer-facing teams to turn customer requirements into SDK deliverables and commitments.
Establish engineering practices for code review, continuous integration, release management, quality metrics, security response and open source license compliance.

Key Requirements

BS/MS in computer science, electrical engineering or a related field, with a minimum of 15 years of total experience in embedded software, including at least 5 years of people management/supervisory experience.
Proven track record of building, scaling and retaining high-performance engineering teams, and of working as a peer with leaders at other sites to deliver across multiple geographies and time zones.
Proven track record of delivering complex software products or SDKs to external customers.
Hands-on experience developing firmware, boot code and software for high-performance 64-bit Arm processors.
Hands-on experience with U-Boot, including porting, customization and debugging.
Hands-on experience with secure boot, including chain of trust, image signing and verification, and key management.
Experience with embedded RTOS (e.g. QNX) in a product environment.
Experience with hypervisors, including running and supporting guest operating systems on Arm.
Deep experience with Linux kernel and device driver development, including SPI, I2C, USB, PCIe, MIPI, Ethernet and eMMC.
Experience working with silicon teams on pre-silicon verification, post-silicon bring-up and troubleshooting.
Strong proficiency in C/C++, and the technical depth to review architecture and design decisions and to contribute code when needed.
Experience with embedded Linux build systems (e.g. Yocto) and Debian Linux is highly desirable.
Experience with Docker is highly desirable.
Experience building on open source software frameworks and working with open source communities is highly desirable.
Experience with SDKs for AI/ML accelerators or edge SoCs is a plus.

Personal Attributes:

Strong leader and team builder who sets clear goals and holds people and themselves accountable. Collaborative with peers at other sites and comfortable working across time zones. Execution and results-oriented, self-driven and curious, with good judgment on technical trade-offs. Communicates clearly with engineers, executives and customers.

The annual salary for this position ranges from $231,100 - $358,200. The actual annual salary offered will depend on several factors, including - among others - job-related skills, experience, technical expertise, qualifications, work location, and business needs. The annual salary range for this position is subject to change and may be adjusted in the future.

This role requires a unique combination of AI technical depth, platform systems expertise, and ecosystem influence to deliver industry-leading AI experiences spanning AI PCs, generative AI, multimodal AI, agentic AI, AI developer platforms, and future Snapdragon compute architectures. The role operates at the intersection of architecture, hardware, systems, software, AI algorithms, developer tools, and ecosystem enablement.

AI Strategy and Technical Leadership

Define and execute Qualcomm's AI software strategy for Windows on Snapdragon platforms.
Drive creation of differentiated AI experiences leveraging Snapdragon CPUs, NPUs, GPUs, and heterogeneous compute architectures.
Influence future AI platform architecture requirements, software roadmaps, and ecosystem strategy.
Establish long-term technology direction for on-device AI, generative AI, large language models, multimodal AI, computer vision, and agentic AI workloads.
Partner with Compute, AI Software, System, Product Management, Customer Engineering, and Architecture teams to align investment priorities and execution plans.

Drive co-engineering activities across Windows AI, WinML, Windows AI Foundry, ONNX Runtime, Copilot+, and next-generation Windows AI capabilities.
Partner with Microsoft engineering organizations to define platform requirements, feature roadmaps, validation strategies, and performance targets.
Lead engagements with OEMs, commercial customers, independent software vendors, and open-source communities to expand the AI ecosystem on Snapdragon PCs.
Represent Qualcomm in executive-level technical discussions with strategic partners.

AI Platform and Systems Engineering

Lead teams responsible for end-to-end AI software enablement across Snapdragon compute products.
Drive optimization of AI workloads across NPU, GPU, CPU, and hybrid execution environments.
Oversee AI runtime integration, model deployment frameworks, developer tooling, and software release readiness.

Define benchmarking strategy and performance targets for AI workloads.
Drive leadership results across industry benchmarks and customer-facing workloads.
Establish performance measurement methodologies and competitive analysis processes.
Lead optimization efforts required to achieve benchmark leadership across Snapdragon PC platforms.

Build, scale, and develop a high-performing global AI engineering organization.
Recruit and retain world-class talent across AI systems, machine learning, software engineering, performance engineering, and developer technologies.
Establish organizational structure, priorities, metrics, and execution frameworks.
Mentor directors, senior managers, architects, and technical leaders.
Foster a culture of innovation, accountability, technical excellence, and rapid execution.

Program Execution and Product Delivery

Own execution of AI software deliverables across multiple Snapdragon Compute programs.
Manage cross-functional dependencies spanning silicon, firmware, drivers, AI runtimes, operating systems, developer tools, applications, and ecosystem partners.
Ensure timely delivery of AI features aligned with product milestones and customer commitments.
Drive issue resolution, risk management, quality initiatives, and operational excellence.

Providing supervision to other supervisors/managers who may be direct reports.

jobs.description:
Responsibilities

MaxLinear is seeking a Director of Product Engineering to join our team. In this role, you will focus on the following:

Build and mentor engineering talent while fostering a culture of technical excellence, accountability, and innovation
Drive seamless transition of products from design to manufacturing and own product manufacturing performance throughout the entire product lifecycle
Lead product bring-up, silicon validation, characterization, qualification, and production release activities
Define organizational strategy, goals, KPIs, and resource plans aligned with company objectives
Collaborate closely with cross functional organizations to optimize performance, yield, testability, and manufacturability
Establish manufacturing readiness criteria and ensure successful product ramp
Own product yield improvement initiatives across wafer fabrication, assembly, and final test operations
Implement statistical process control (SPC), DOE, FMEA, and advanced analytics techniques.
Analyze product and test data to identify yield detractors and implement corrective actions
Develop strategies to improve cost of test, manufacturing efficiency, and overall product margins
Support customer escalations, product quality investigations, and field-return analysis
Establish and manage OSAT scorecards and KPIs to ensure world-class execution in quality, yield, cost, delivery, and cycle time

Qualifications

Experience with releasing products on advanced CMOS Process nodes (16nm and below)
Deep knowledge of mm-wave, RF, Mixed signal and CMOS logic circuit principles
Knowledge and experience with ATE (Automatic Test Equipment), such as Verigy and Teradyne
Experience with Data Analysis S/W such as Galaxy, Data Conductor or DataPower to create Characterization Reports and monitor production Yield
Experience recruiting, managing, and mentoring an engineering team
BS in Electrical Engineering or related + 13 years of experience, or MS + 11 years of experience, or Ph.D. + 8 years of experience

Compensation And Benefits

MaxLinear has a Total Compensation philosophy which includes base salary and annual discretionary bonus eligibility and many positions also include stock-based compensation.

MaxLinear's good faith estimate starting base salary range is: $ 187,000 to $251 , Annually

We offer competitive benefits designed to support employee health, welfare, and retirement and some highlights are: health care benefits, 401k savings plan, Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP), and paid time off.

The actual starting base salary will be determined by the match to certain role-related criteria such as educational degree(s) or equivalent, relevant work experience, skillset needed for the role, and geographic location; this is not an all-inclusive list as some roles may require unique skills or experience.

Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to, and will not be discriminated against based on race, sex, religion, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, or protected veteran status.

Company Overview

MaxLinear is a global, NASDAQ-traded company (MXL) where the entrepreneurial spirit is alive and well. We are a fabless system-on-chip product company, striving to improve the world’s communication networks for everyone through our highly integrated radio-frequency (RF), analog, digital, and mixed-signal semiconductor solutions for access and connectivity, wired and wireless infrastructure, and industrial and multi-market applications.

We hire the best people in the industry and engage them in some of the most exciting opportunities that connect the world we live in today. Our growth has come from innovative, bold approaches to solving some of the world’s most challenging communication technology problems in the most efficient and effective manner.

MaxLinear began by developing the world’s first high-performance TV tuner chip using standard CMOS process technology. Others said we couldn’t achieve the extremely high-performance requirements using CMOS, but we proved them wrong and achieved enduring global market leadership with our designs. Since then, we’ve developed a full line of products that drive 4G and 5G infrastructure; enable data center, metro and long-haul optical interconnects; bring 10Gbit to the home; power the IoT revolution; and enable robust and reliable communication in harsh industrial environments. Over the years, we’ve expanded through organic growth and through several acquisitions that have perfectly complemented our existing portfolio and enabled us to deliver complete end-to-end solutions in our target markets. One such example was the acquisition of Intel’s Home Gateway Platform Division that added Wi-Fi, Ethernet, and Broadband Gateway Processor SoC technology to our connected home portfolio creating a complete and scalable platform of connectivity and access solutions to fully address our customers’ needs.

Our headquarters are in Carlsbad, near San Diego, California. We also have major design centers in Irvine and San Jose, California; Valencia, Spain; Bangalore, India; Munich, Germany; Israel; and Singapore.

We have approximately 1,200 employees, a substantial majority of whom have engineering degrees and include masters and Ph.D. graduates from many of the premiere universities around the world. Our employees thrive on innovation, outstanding execution, outside-the-box thinking, nimbleness, and collaboration. Together, we form a high-energy business team that is focused on building the best and most innovative products on the market.

Strategic Investments - Engineering Governance and Standards

jobs.title: Senior Director, Context and Semantics Engineering (AI)
jobs.description:
Your work days are brighter here.

We’re obsessed with making hard work pay off, for our people, our customers, and the world around us. As a Fortune 500 company and a leading AI platform for managing people, money, and agents, we’re shaping the future of work so teams can reach their potential and focus on what matters most. The minute you join, you’ll feel it. Not just in the products we build, but in how we show up for each other. Our culture is rooted in integrity, empathy, and shared enthusiasm. We’re in this together, tackling big challenges with bold ideas and genuine care. We look for curious minds and courageous collaborators who bring sun-drenched optimism and drive. Whether you're building smarter solutions, supporting customers, or creating a space where everyone belongs, you’ll do meaningful work with Workmates who’ve got your back. In return, we’ll give you the trust to take risks, the tools to grow, the skills to develop and the support of a company invested in you for the long haul. So, if you want to inspire a brighter work day for everyone, including yourself, you’ve found a match in Workday, and we hope to be a match for you too.

About The Team

The Data Cloud organization is at the forefront of Workday’s next major wave of innovation, driven by a bold mandate to build the industry’s first true Platform for Agents. We are a high-energy, ambitious team that balances Workday's deep foundational expertise with fresh, forward-thinking perspectives to accelerate our pace of delivery and unlock massive new commercial value. By leveraging Workday’s unique business context, trusted data, and identity guardrails, we are building the critical engine that will power the future of AI and agentic workflows across the enterprise. As a team, we value organizational clarity, deep cross-functional collaboration, and rapid execution, working together to evolve our architecture and aggressively scale our impact in the market.

Join the Data Cloud organization, where we are building the intelligent foundation for Workday's next generation of AI Agents. The Context and Semantics Engineering team is the brain trust responsible for making our AI "enterprise-aware." We build the semantic layers, knowledge graphs, and dynamic context engines that ground generative AI in real-world HR and Finance data. By bridging the gap between raw enterprise data and large language models (LLMs), our team ensures that Workday’s autonomous agents can reason accurately, securely, and with deep contextual awareness at a global scale.

About The Role

As the Senior Director of Context and Semantics Engineering, you will be a key engineering executive driving the vision, architecture, and delivery of the intelligence layer powering Workday’s AI Agents. You will lead and scale an engineering organization to build highly scalable semantic engines, advanced RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) pipelines, vector search infrastructure, and dynamic context-management systems.

Sitting at the critical intersection of data architecture and applied AI, you will ensure that our foundational models seamlessly understand and reason over complex, highly regulated enterprise workflows. This is a high-visibility, high-impact role requiring a visionary leader who can scale organizations, navigate technical ambiguity, and deliver production-grade AI infrastructure that sets the industry standard for Enterprise AI.

Responsibilities:

Organizational Leadership: Build, scale, and mentor a world-class engineering organization dedicated to AI context, semantic architecture, and data orchestration.
Strategic Technical Vision: Define and execute the technical roadmap for Workday’s AI semantic layer, encompassing vector databases, knowledge graphs, enterprise ontologies, and semantic search capabilities.
AI & RAG Infrastructure: Lead the development of enterprise-grade RAG pipelines, ensuring LLMs are grounded in real-time, accurate, and tenant-isolated HR and Finance data to eliminate hallucinations and drive agentic reasoning.
Cross-Functional Executive Partnership: Collaborate tightly with VP/C-level stakeholders across AI/ML Engineering, Product Management, and Platform Architecture to seamlessly integrate context engines into the broader AI Agent Factory and Sana experiences.
Context & Memory Management: Drive the engineering design for agentic memory, state management, and conversational context, allowing our AI agents to seamlessly handle multi-turn, complex user workflows.
Responsible & Governed AI: Enforce rigorous technical standards for data privacy, RBAC (Role-Based Access Control), and compliance, ensuring that context fed to AI models strictly adheres to enterprise security boundaries.
Innovation & Scale: Evaluate and integrate cutting-edge AI data technologies and orchestration frameworks (e.g., advanced embedding models, GraphRAG, LlamaIndex, LangChain) to future-proof Workday's AI platform at massive scale.

About You

Basic Qualifications:

10+ years of progressive software engineering experience with a strong background in distributed systems, search architectures, data platforms, or AI infrastructure.
5+ years of senior engineering leadership experience (Director level or above), with a proven track record of managing managers, scaling organizations (50+ engineers), and delivering mission-critical enterprise systems.
3+ years of direct experience leading teams that build AI/ML infrastructure, semantic search engines, LLM orchestration layers, vector databases, or Knowledge Graphs.

Other Qualifications:

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field (Ph.D. is a plus).
Deep architectural understanding of how to bridge structured enterprise data with unstructured AI models (RAG architectures, embedding generation, chunking strategies, and semantic routing).
Experience building and scaling Semantic Layers, Ontologies, or enterprise-scale Search/Retrieval systems (e.g., Elasticsearch, Pinecone, Milvus, Neo4j).
Strong executive presence and communication skills, with the ability to translate complex AI and data concepts into clear business value for non-technical stakeholders.
Product-first mindset with a relentless focus on delivering high-reliability, low-latency infrastructure that powers real-time AI user experiences.
Experience operating within highly regulated data environments (Finance/HR) and implementing AI guardrails for enterprise-grade security.
Experience with the Workday platform and architecture is a strong plus.

With Flex Work, we’re combining the best of both worlds: in-person time and remote. Our approach enables our teams to deepen connections, maintain a strong community, and do their best work. We know that flexibility can take shape in many ways, so rather than a number of required days in-office each week, we simply spend at least half (50%) of our time each quarter in the office or in the field
with our customers, prospects, and partners (depending on role). If you love working at the intersection of community, content, and cutting-edge technology, you’ll feel right at home here.

Director of Process Engineering

You in this Role
You are a disciplined engineering leader who excels at scaling manufacturing processes and building world-class teams. With a large, dedicated production team focused on high-touch assembly, your mission is to introduce the advanced engineering rigor needed to take our operations to the next level. jobs.description:
About Decagon

Decagon is the leading conversational AI platform empowering every brand to deliver concierge customer experiences.

Our technology enables industry-defining enterprises like Avis Budget Group, Block’s Cash App and Square, Chime, Oura Health, and Hunter Douglas to deploy AI agents that power personalized, deeply satisfying interactions across voice, chat, email, SMS, and every other channel.

We’re building a future where customer experiences are being redefined from support tickets and hold music to faster resolutions, richer conversations, and deeper relationships. We’re proud to be backed by world-class investors who share that vision, including a16z, Accel, Bain Capital Ventures, Coatue, and Index Ventures, along with many others.

We’re an in-office company, driven by a shared commitment to excellence and velocity. Our values — Just Get It Done, Invent What Customers Want, Winner’s Mindset, and The Polymath Principle — shape how we work and grow as a team.

About The Team

Over the past few years, development of LLMs has evolved at a rapid pace. It’s not enough for our customers to just “set it and forget it” when it comes to AI software. Truly successful AI Agents require hands-on execution, rigorous iteration, and deep technical delivery to reach enterprise-grade performance.

We’re creating an Agent Deployment Engineering Org
: a specialized technical delivery team responsible for end-to-end execution of AI agent builds. Agent Deployment Engineers own the hands-on work required to deliver best-in-class agents—writing and configuring key components, validating integrations, and ensuring agents perform reliably at scale. This team brings greater specialization and focus to build quality. Agent Deployment Engineers are technical and customer-facing: interfacing with senior technical stakeholders while going deep on agent configuration and build execution.

About The Role

As Director of Agent Deployment Engineering
, you will lead Decagon’s technical delivery for strategic enterprise customers—owning outcomes across multiple deployments and building the team, playbooks, and operating system required to scale. This is a senior, customer-facing leadership role where you’ll partner with customer executives and technical leaders to define success, translate requirements into delivery plans, and drive launches that measurably impact customer outcomes.

You’ll work closely with Agent PMs, Agent Success, Engineering, and GTM leadership to create tight feedback loops: driving delivery, surfacing product gaps, and influencing the evolution of Decagon’s agent-building platform based on real enterprise needs. This role is ideal for a leader who thrives in fast-moving environments, enjoys shipping customer-facing technical work, and can balance hands-on problem solving with structured execution at scale.

In this role, you will

Lead and scale a high-performing delivery org
Own end-to-end execution of AI agent deployments for enterprise customers across a portfolio, from scoping through launch and iteration.
Build, lead, and develop a team of Agent Builders; hire, coach, and set a high bar for quality, velocity, and customer outcomes.
Establish delivery operating rhythms (planning, reviews, retros), capacity planning, and forecasting to ensure predictable execution.

Drive executive-level customer engagements
Interface with senior technical stakeholders and executives to define success criteria, align on constraints (security/compliance), and drive delivery against timelines.
Lead complex escalations and unblock cross-functional teams when quality, timelines, or customer outcomes are at risk.
Translate customer needs into crisp internal documentation and execution plans across Product/Engineering/GTM.

Create repeatable playbooks and scale mechanisms
Define and standardize delivery methodologies and artifacts (e.g., AOP quality bar, launch readiness checklists, iteration loops).
Establish best practices for evaluation and guardrails to ensure safe, compliant, and predictable agent performance in real-world scenarios.
Improve tooling and processes to reduce time-to-launch and increase reliability across deployments.

Influence the platform roadmap through deployment insights
Identify recurring product/platform gaps and drive prioritization with Engineering and Product leadership.
Partner with internal teams to turn real customer needs into platform improvements that compound across deployments.

Your background looks something like this

10+ years of relevant experience in technical, customer-facing roles (e.g., forward-deployed engineering, solutions engineering, technical consulting, implementation engineering, technical product/PM, or similar).
5+ years of people management experience, including hiring, coaching, performance management, and building high-performing teams; ideally experience leading senior ICs and/or managers.
Strong technical foundation—comfortable working with APIs, integrations, and complex systems; able to go deep to diagnose issues and guide solution architecture.
Experience delivering production-grade customer solutions that require structured execution, testing/validation, and iteration.
Ability to communicate clearly with senior technical stakeholders, translate requirements into execution plans, and drive delivery.
Comfort operating in fast-moving, ambiguous environments where you build structure while maintaining momentum.

Even better if you have

Experience deploying LLM-based products or AI agents in production (prompting, evaluation, guardrails, tooling, workflow design).
Experience with enterprise SaaS integrations (e.g., ticketing systems, CRM, data pipelines) and security/compliance considerations.
Strong product instincts—ability to define success metrics, write crisp requirements, and contribute customer insight back into product roadmap.
Experience scaling a delivery function from high-touch execution to repeatable playbooks and durable operating cadence.

Job Description

General Summary:

This role leads a team responsible for the architecture, delivery, security, support, and continuous evolution of enterprise laboratory technology platforms across LC1/2, Vertex's Cell & Gene Therapy (CGT) site. It is also the single accountable Research Site Partner for LC1/2: the primary DTE relationship holder for the site leadership, and the front door through which site requirements are captured, shaped, and routed into the correct cross-functional platform backlog.

Operating within highly regulated GxP and SOX environments, this role remains accountable for operational excellence, financial stewardship, and risk management across a complex laboratory technology landscape, including ownership of the site's annual operating budget. In parallel, the role carries accountability for local technology adoption, change management, and cross-site prioritization advocacy — ensuring LC1/2's voice shapes the shared platform roadmap without the site building or maintaining local one-off solutions.

Key Duties And Responsibilities

Technology & Operations Leadership

Build and sustain strong, trust-based relationships with senior business, quality, and DTE leaders, acting as a strategic partner with sustained impact on enterprise laboratory goals.
Lead, develop, and retain a highly effective Lab Engineering Support organization, leveraging internal resources and external partners through a managed service provider model.
Ensure stable, secure, and compliant laboratory technology operations across both IT and OT environments, aligned to cyber security, ITSM, ITIL, and DTE system lifecycle standards.
Serve as the primary point of accountability for laboratory technology operating within GxP- and SOX-regulated environments, partnering with DTE Compliance, Cyber Security, Internal Audit, and Quality Assurance.
Own and manage the site's operating budget, ensuring disciplined financial planning, forecasting, vendor management, and value realization across services and platforms.
Oversee a portfolio of programs, projects, platform releases, and enhancements delivered at the site, ensuring quality, timeliness, and alignment with business outcomes.
Lead technology-driven modernization of the laboratory environment — intelligent automation, agentic workflows, passive data capture, IoT-enabled instruments, and connected lab environments — translating innovation into pragmatic, compliant roadmaps.
Attract, develop, and retain top talent; carry full people-management accountability for assigned staff.

Site Partnership

Serve as the single accountable owner for technology adoption, change, and the DTE relationship at LC1/2 — the primary partner to the site leadership.
Engage directly with Cell & Gene Therapy leadership, translating CGT modality context into technology requirements without relying on an intermediary domain translator. CGT-specific regulatory and quality compliance is owned by the platform/quality teams, not this role.
Act as the site's product owner: capture requirements and user stories directly from scientists and shape raw, ambiguous input into clear, prioritized demand.
Be the single front door for LC1/2 — route shaped requirements to the correct platform owner (within Laboratory Solutions or peer DTE platform organizations) rather than site stakeholders engaging each platform team directly.
Drive local adoption and change management for new platform capabilities; carry roadmap and delivery updates back to site scientists and leadership on a regular cadence.
Represent the site's voice in cross-site, cross-functional prioritization forums, ensuring the shared platform roadmap reflects the site's highest-value needs.
Maintain a transparent, current view of the site's demand status and backlog position that site stakeholders can see and understand.

Knowledge And Skills

Strong senior-level business engagement and stakeholder partnership capabilities.
Working fluency in CGT modality concepts sufficient to be seen as credible by research leadership and scientists, not just by technology stakeholders.
Deep understanding of enterprise technology operations, cyber security, ITSM, and system lifecycle practices.
Proven people leadership experience building and sustaining high-performing teams.
Program, portfolio, demand, and financial management expertise.
Excellent analytical, problem-solving, communication, and executive-level presentation skills.
Ability to balance operational stability with innovation in regulated environments.
Comfort operating in a matrixed accountability model — shaping and routing demand where the build/architecture decision rests with a peer platform owner, not this role.
Preferred, not required: experience with Benchling and fit-for-purpose analytics/visualization software — a strong addition to the candidate profile but not mandatory.

Education And Experience

Bachelor's degree in technology discipline or equivalent
10+ years of relevant experience, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
3+ years of experience in the Cell & Gene Therapy space — general modality fluency is sufficient; deep hands-on process/manufacturing experience is not required.

About The Role

Fora is looking for a Senior Engineering Manager to lead and empower several cross-functional sprint teams on Fora’s Finance pod. Our pod’s mission is to build the financial operating system for a new generation of travel entrepreneurs, owning the complete lifecycle from ingesting bookings and collecting commissions from suppliers to giving advisors transparency into their earnings and paying them quickly, accurately, and seamlessly. You’ll collaborate closely with Product, Design, Operations, and your engineering teams to set strategy, steer architecture, and drive impactful business outcomes across multiple teams. Our rails processed commission payments on over $1B in travel last year, so your work will involve figuring out how to move fast and stay nimble while operating on a system where pivot costs are high, errors lose money, and downtime is not an option.

We expect our managers to be masters of the craft and be able to go deep into the details, mastering the fundamentals and honing their skills. The ideal candidate is a first principles thinker who is passionate about developing people, driving technical excellence, and achieving sustainable business results through thoughtful leadership and collaboration.

Key Responsibilities

Collaborate with Product and Design to shape product strategy, ensuring that your team builds the right solutions that drive the highest impact on the business.
Improve team efficiency and engineering velocity, ensuring your team delivers value quickly without compromising on quality, maintainability, or reliability.
Guide architecture and technical decisions, balancing trade-offs and proactively anticipating future issues to ensure robust and scalable solutions.
Drive operational excellence across reliability, performance, cost-efficiency, design consistency, and maintainable code.
Promote high team engagement, employee happiness, continuous skill development, and professional growth.
Mentor engineers, provide constructive feedback, and support direct reports to help them overcome challenges and deliver on ambitious goals.
Perform hands-on technical work, contributing to code reviews, debugging, and implementing functionality.
Participate in hiring processes and attracting top engineering talent to support the continued growth of your team and our organization.

Requirements

4+ years of experience in engineering leadership roles (e.g., Engineering Manager or Tech Lead) in the consumer-facing fintech space, including 1+ years of experience managing managers.
8+ years experience in web systems development.
Demonstrated ability to mentor engineers, effectively manage performance, and build highly motivated, engaged teams.
Strong technical acumen, with experience making informed architectural decisions, addressing technical debt, and setting robust engineering standards.
Exceptional project management and organizational skills, including the ability to break down complex projects, anticipate risks, and deliver consistently high-quality outcomes.
Excellent communication skills, able to translate technical concepts clearly to diverse stakeholders and facilitate productive, drama-free project launches.
Proven recruiting experience, capable of evaluating engineering candidates effectively and representing the company positively.
A collaborative, empathetic leadership style that emphasizes humility, openness to feedback, accountability, and continuous learning.
Entrepreneurial mindset and comfort working in an early- to mid-stage startup environment where ambiguity and pace are part of the fun.
First-principles thinker who carefully evaluates each problem, thoughtfully choosing between established best practices and bespoke solutions, especially when designing team processes and norms.

Compensation

Compensation range for this role can vary depending on experience, and for this role an indicative range is $235k-$250k + equity. Other benefits include:

Unlimited vacation
Health Insurance (including an option completely covered by Fora HQ)
Dental & Vision Insurance
Wellhub Memberships
401k plan with company match
Commuter Benefits
Supplemental Life Insurance
Stock Options

This role is based in our beautiful New York City office (Tribeca/Fidi) with lots of natural light and great views.

We’re forging our own path

Fora has always been about driving change within the industry. We’re not interested in maintaining the status quo.

We’re stronger together

Community is our cornerstone and collective power is our strength. We believe we can all go further when we operate together, using our combined leverage to unlock better opportunities and outcomes for our advisors, partners, and travelers.

We believe in technology

We believe technology is an answer to some of the most fundamental challenges the travel industry faces. We’re here to serve

We mean business

Fora is equal parts fun, meaningful work and serious travel business. We’re unlocking opportunities for thousands of travel entrepreneurs, delivering a stream of high-quality guests at scale for our partners, and providing a superior travel experience for our travelers. It’s a better equation for the future of our industry.

Position Summary

The Senior Manager, Network Engineering (Americas) is a senior technical leader who partners with peer leaders and solution architects to shape network engineering strategy and technology roadmap, while owning execution, delivery, and budget for the Americas region, spanning sites throughout North America and Latin America. Reporting directly to the VP, Network and Voice Services, this role is a peer to the Network Engineering EMEA, and together the two roles form the discipline based, globally minded leadership structure for network engineering. The Senior Manager is accountable for operationalizing the technology roadmap, including multi year modernization initiatives such as SD WAN and SASE adoption, network observability maturity, and budget ownership for the Americas region, while partnering with the Principal Architect and solution architects on global reference designs and standards. This is a strategic, hands on leadership role for someone who can operate at both the whiteboard and the executive table.

Key Responsibilities

Partner with peer leaders and solution architects to shape technology strategy and roadmap, while owning execution, delivery, and budget for the Americas region, including modernization of the WAN through SD WAN and secure access service edge (SASE) architectures.
Drive maturity of network observability across the region, including monitoring, telemetry, and automation platforms that reduce mean time to detect and resolve incidents.
Own the Americas network engineering budget, including capital and operating expense planning, vendor and circuit cost management, and business case development for major initiatives.
Lead contract negotiations and manage strategic vendor and carrier relationships across the region, in partnership with procurement and sourcing.
Lead, develop, and scale the Americas network engineering team with sites across North America and Latin America, building the team into a layered organization as headcount grows.
Own delivery of network engineering projects across the full Americas footprint, including WAN, data center, cloud networking, and wireless initiatives at sites throughout North America and Latin America.
Serve as the senior escalation point for network infrastructure issues across the Americas, driving root cause analysis and long term reliability improvements in partnership with the NOC and cross functional teams.
Partner with the Network Engineering EMEA, the Principal Architect, and solution architects to align Americas delivery with global reference designs and standards, and to drive consistency in SD WAN, SASE, and observability tooling worldwide.
Manage staffing plans, budget discipline, and resourcing across the Americas team, including sourcing decisions across North America and Latin America locations, with Costa Rica serving as a key operational continuity hub.
Present technology strategy, budget requests, and program status to VP and executive stakeholders, translating technical initiatives into business impact and risk.
Represent the Americas network engineering function in leadership planning and future state organization design discussions.

12 or more years of progressive experience in network engineering, including routing, switching, WAN, data center, and cloud networking technologies.

Direct, hands on experience designing, deploying, or operating SD WAN and SASE architectures at enterprise scale.
Experience building or maturing network observability programs, including telemetry, monitoring, and automation.
Demonstrated ownership of a multi million dollar network budget, including capital planning, vendor negotiation, and cost optimization.
Demonstrated experience delivering network projects across multiple sites or regions, with accountability for enterprise scale reliability.
Strong executive communication skills, with a track record of presenting strategy and budget to VP or C suite stakeholders.
Experience managing distributed teams across multiple sites in North America and Latin America.

Industry certifications such as CCNP, CCIE, or equivalent SD WAN and security vendor certifications.
Experience in a global IT distribution, technology services, or similarly complex enterprise environment.
Familiarity with network security and voice or unified communications disciplines, given the close partnership with those functions.
Experience building or scaling a team through a period of organizational change or M and A integration.
Bachelor's degree in a technical field or equivalent experience; advanced degree a plus.
Able to create and conduct formal presentations.
Able to interact effectively with all levels of management.
Able to negotiate skillfully, promote/sell ideas persuasively, and close transactions with mutually beneficial results.

About Us

At Transamerica, hard work, innovative thinking, and personal accountability are qualities we honor and reward. We understand the potential of leveraging the talents of a diverse workforce. Ultimately, we appreciate the uniqueness of a company where talented professionals work collaboratively in a positive environment — one focused on helping people look forward and plan for the best life possible while providing tools and solutions that make it easier to get there.

Who We Are

We believe everyone deserves to live their best life. More than a century ago, we were among the first financial services companies in America to serve everyday people from all walks of life.

Today, we’re part of an international holding company, with millions of customers and thousands of employees worldwide. Our insurance, retirement, and investment solutions help people make the most of what’s important to them.

We’re empowered by a vast agent network covering North America, with diversity to match. Together with our nonprofit research institute and foundation, we tune in, step up, and are a force for good — for our customers and the communities where we live, work, and play. United in our purpose, we help people create the financial freedom to live life on their terms.

What We Do

Transamerica is organized into three distinct businesses. These include 1) World Financial Group, including Transamerica Financial Advisors, 2) Protection Solutions and Savings & Investments, comprised of life insurance, annuities, employee benefits, retirement plans, and Transamerica Investment Solutions, and 3) Financial Assets, which includes legacy blocks of long term care, universal life, and variable and fixed annuities. These are supported by Transamerica Corporate, which includes Finance, People and Places, General Counsel, Risk, Internal Audit, Strategy and Development, and Corporate Affairs, which covers Communications, Brand, and Government and Policy Affairs.

jobs.description:
Job Description

The Role

The Vehicle Experiences Engine (VEE) at GM is transforming how millions of people interact with their vehicles. At the foundation of that transformation is the Core OS group
— the team that builds the high-performance operating-system foundation on which GM's next generation of vehicle software runs. Our work spans hypervisors and virtualization, safety and health management, containerization, and the core OS services that let multiple operating systems — Linux, Android, and QNX — share a single high-compute platform safely and efficiently.

As Senior Software Engineering Manager, Core OS, you will build this team from the ground up. You'll define the charter, hire the founding engineers, set the architecture, and establish how the Core OS layer interfaces with the silicon, guest OS, and vehicle program teams around it. You will be accountable for both standing up the team and delivering its first production milestones.

This is a defining opportunity to shape the future of software-defined mobility: the platform your organization builds determines the computing efficiency, responsiveness, scalability, reliability of every experience layered on top of it, and across every vehicle program that ships on it — and makes GM's vehicles smarter, safer, and continuously upgradeable.

What You’ll Do:

Lead and grow a high-performing engineering organization of senior engineers and engineering leaders, fostering technical excellence, innovation, and continuous improvement.
Own the roadmap and delivery of the core OS layer: hypervisor and virtualization, virtual machine lifecycle and resource partitioning, inter-VM communication, and the boot and secure-boot chain.
Deliver the safety-relevant foundation of the compute platform — freedom from interference between partitions, health monitoring, fault detection, and recovery — in partnership with functional safety and cybersecurity teams.
Establish on-vehicle container and workload management, including runtime isolation, lifecycle management, resource governance, and updateability of platform workloads.
Enable multiple guest operating systems — embedded Linux (Yocto), Android, and QNX — on shared compute, with consistent platform services, interfaces, and tooling across all of them.
Set and drive platform KPIs for compute efficiency, responsiveness, startup and boot time, memory footprint, scalability, and reliability.
Drive cross-functional collaboration with BSP and silicon enablement, application platform, cybersecurity, functional safety, and vehicle program teams to ensure seamless integration.

jobs.description:
The Senior Manager Service Engineering
leads a team dedicated to ensuring products, systems, and equipment are designed and supported for maximum serviceability, minimal downtime, and optimal lifecycle cost. The Senior Manager leads a team of Global Service Engineers responsible for developing service strategies, Service Bills of Material (sBOMs), Level of Repair Analyses (LORA), service documentation requirements, and product improvement initiatives. The manager provides both technical oversight and organizational leadership to embed maintainability principles throughout the product lifecycle.

Responsibilities

Develop and maintain a formal Level of Repair Analysis (LORA) process across all product platforms.
Define repair-versus-replace strategies at the component, assembly, and system levels.
Evaluate repair decisions based on lifecycle cost, reliability, maintainability, service complexity, and customer impact.
Establish repairability standards for major generator subsystems including engines, alternators, control systems, power electronics, fuel systems, and transfer switches.
Utilize LORA outcomes to influence product architecture, service parts strategy, and maintenance planning.
Own the strategy, development, governance, and continuous improvement of Service Bills of Material (sBOMs).
Establish processes for transforming Engineering Bills of Material (eBOMs) into service-ready structures.
Define service assemblies, service kits, replacement components, and maintenance parts required to support products throughout their lifecycle.
Partner with Product Engineering, Supply Chain, Manufacturing, and Product Management to ensure accurate service parts planning.
Ensure service BOM structures are maintained within PLM, ERP, and aftermarket support systems.
Drive service parts simplification and standardization initiatives to optimize inventory and lifecycle support costs.
Establish service parts readiness requirements for all new product introductions.
Design and direct the work of the team.
Select, coach, and develop staff.
Set clear expectations to inspire and motivate the team.
Manage performance by recognizing achievement, providing feedback, and administering progressive discipline when necessary.
Oversee and assign activities and responsibilities for projects assigned to ensure timelines and budgets are met.
Lead Engineers through the implementation of new technologies and equipment.
Define resource needs and works within budget and staffing parameters to accomplish objectives for area of responsibility.

Minimum Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Mechanical, Electrical, or related degree OR 8 years related experience in the Engineering and Service Engineering function within a similar working environment.
10 years’ experience working and supporting a product service organization 5 years of progressive Engineering and/or product service management experience in similar work environment.
Experience with development and maintenance of engineered products.
Experience using SAP/MRP or equivalent ERP.

Preferred Qualifications

Advanced degree in Engineering, Technical Management or Business Management.
15 years’ experience with a focus on maintainability, service engineering, or product architecture.
Familiarity with principles and practices of budget preparation and administration.
Experience working with field service operations, service organizations, or aftermarket support.
Deep understanding of maintainability analysis methods, service architecture, and design-for-maintainability best practices.
Demonstrated success implementing maintainability standards across large engineering organizations.

Knowledge / Skills / Abilities

Service Bill of Material (sBOM) development and governance.
Level of Repair Analysis (LORA) methodologies.
Design for Serviceability (DFS).
Product Lifecycle Management (PLM).
Service parts strategy and lifecycle support planning.
Warranty and reliability analytics.
Lean principles and continuous improvement methodologies.
Financial acumen and understanding of key business metrics.
Knowledge of GEIA-STD-0007, MIL-STD-1388, or similar standards.
Ability to influence and collaborate across functions.
Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

Physical Demands

jobs.title: Sr. Engineering Manager, Frontline Engineering
jobs.description:
Job Description

We are Omnissa!

Omnissa is the first AI-driven digital work platform, built to support flexible, secure, work-from anywhere experiences. We integrate industry-leading solutions—including Unified Endpoint Management, Virtual Apps and Desktops, Digital Employee Experience, and Security & Compliance—into a seamless, autonomous workspace that adapts to how people work. Our platform boosts employee engagement while optimizing IT operations, security, and cost.

Guided by our Core Values— Act in Alignment, Build Trust, Foster Inclusiveness, Drive Efficiency, and Maximize Customer Value
—we’re growing rapidly and committed to delivering meaningful impact. If you're passionate about shaping the future of work, we’d love to hear from you.

At Omnissa, we are committed to maintaining a fair, consistent, and secure hiring process for all candidates. As part of this approach, we use standard interview and verification practices designed to ensure alignment and protect both candidates and the organization. These practices are applied thoughtfully and with respect for candidate privacy.

What is the opportunity?

We are looking for an experienced Engineering Manager to lead our Frontline Engineering team within UEM Engineering. This team serves as a critical bridge between customers, Support, and Product Engineering. The team takes ownership of complex and high-impact customer escalations that require deep technical investigation, helping identify root causes, drive issues toward resolution, and ensure that learnings from escalations translate into improvements in product quality and engineering practices. As the Engineering Manager, you will build and lead a team of strong technical engineers who can independently investigate complex issues across the Workspace ONE UEM platform. You will partner closely with Product Engineering, Technical Support, Product Management, TPMs, and Quality Engineering to improve escalation handling and reduce recurring customer issues. You will also help evolve the Frontline Engineering function by leveraging AI, automation, and improved diagnostics to accelerate investigations, reduce manual effort, identify recurring patterns, and turn customer escalations into actionable engineering insights. This is an engineering leadership role with a strong focus on technical depth, customer impact, operational excellence, AI-driven innovation, and continuous product improvement.

What You’ll Do

Build, lead, mentor, and develop a high-performing team of Frontline Engineers.
Own engineering engagement and execution for complex, high-priority customer escalations.
Act as the frontline layer for Product Engineering, absorbing and resolving escalations so development teams experience less unplanned, interrupt-driven work and can focus on planned roadmap execution.
Establish clear processes for escalation intake, prioritization, investigation, ownership, and resolution.
Partner closely with Product Engineering teams to troubleshoot complex issues and identify defects, regressions, configuration issues, and product gaps.
Drive strong RCA practices, including clear documentation of root causes, contributing factors, corrective actions, and preventive measures.
Identify patterns and trends across customer escalations and translate those insights into product and quality improvements.
Partner with Quality Engineering and development teams to identify gaps in test coverage and recommend additional automated or regression testing based on real-world customer issues.
Help prioritize fixes and patch candidates based on customer impact, severity, risk, and technical analysis.
Drive the adoption of AI-assisted tools to improve escalation triage, troubleshooting, root-cause analysis, and resolution time.
Identify opportunities to use AI to analyze logs, telemetry, historical escalations, and known issues to accelerate technical investigations.
Leverage AI and automation to identify recurring failure patterns and proactively surface potential product quality issues.
Define and track metrics that measure the effectiveness of the Frontline Engineering function, including escalation volume, resolution time, recurring issues across customers, and reduction in Product Engineering time spent on escalations.
Develop engineers’ technical depth and their ability to independently troubleshoot complex distributed systems and enterprise environments.
Participate in hiring and growing the Frontline Engineering organization as the function expands.

What will you bring to Omnissa?

Proven experience leading engineers in software engineering, escalation engineering, sustaining engineering, or a similar technical organization.
Strong technical background with experience troubleshooting complex enterprise software and distributed systems.
Experience investigating production or customer-reported issues and driving them through root-cause analysis and resolution.
Strong understanding of software development, testing, debugging, release, and patching processes.
Ability to work across engineering teams and drive resolution when issues span multiple components or ownership boundaries.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify patterns across seemingly unrelated customer issues.
Experience using logs, telemetry, diagnostics, APIs, databases, and other troubleshooting tools to investigate complex technical problems.

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Data Engineering
jobs.description:
Strength in Trust

OneTrust’s mission is to enable innovation through the responsible use of data and AI. We believe that ensuring data is trusted shouldn’t slow teams down—it should accelerate what’s possible. This led us to develop the first technology platform for responsible data use in 2016. Today, with AI representing the latest and most impactful expansion of data yet, OneTrust is once again redefining what responsible innovation looks like. OneTrust, the AI‑Ready Governance Platform™, unifies regulatory intelligence, automation, and connected governance workflows so businesses can continue to move at the speed of AI while ensuring good governance to prevent data misuse at scale. Trusted by thousands of organizations worldwide, OneTrust is shaping the future where trusted data becomes a transformative force for business and society.

The Challenge

As Senior Manager, Data Engineering and Platform you will be a people leader of a team of Data Engineers responsible for creating platform and data engineering architecture for business intelligence and data science solutions. This role will have a substantial focus on coaching and people management alongside a strong individual contributor component in hands-on data engineering.

Your Mission

You will work closely with other team members like data architects and business analysts to understand what the business is trying to achieve, move data from source to target, and design optimal data models.

Develop and adhere to standard methodologies: platform architecture, data engineering, data quality, analysis, validation to ensure the team provides quality work to company and build trust with analytics solutions.
Propose and socialize data architecture to enable OneTrust business analytics.
Drive technical conversations with stakeholders to explore all facets of problem and solution.
Solve immediate production issues with an eye to solve things for long-term.
Work with vendors and security teams for appropriate data controls.
Partner with cross functional teams to align on product usage data, business data, development standards and overall data strategy.
Design and build facts, dimensions, snapshots, SCDs in Snowflake/Databricks using dbt/airflow/elt tools. Maintain robust, trusted data models.
Hire and retain top data engineering talent.
Assist in the growth of each employee through coaching and career development activities.

You Are

Seeking someone who can leverage a deep technical understanding of data engineering, data warehousing, and data architecture while leading and motivating an on-call team of engineers in a challenging, dynamic environment.

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
10+ years of professional data engineering experience. Acting as an incident commander during critical outages.
Extensive experience with data architecture, tool evaluations, data modeling, and building ETL pipelines.
Experience working in high-growth, fast-paced environment.
Experience working with distributed teams across geos.
Experience evaluating new data engineering tools and enriching existing architecture.
Strong data warehouse knowledge and ability to write complex SQL for processing raw data, data validation, and QA.
Experience with Python and manipulation of various data formats for extraction and transformation.

Extra Awesome

Experience using AI in a data engineering context
Experience managing distributed teams across geos.
Experience in designing Data Warehouse: ACV, ARR, Event History, Identity Resolution, Deferred Revenue, Revenue Metrics, Experimentation, Audience
Growth Learner: Desire to continue to learn about the future architecture of data technologies.

For California, Colorado, Connecticut, Nevada, New York, Rhode Island, and Washington-based candidates: the annual base pay range for this role is listed below. Within this range, individual pay is determined by several factors, including location, job-related skills, work experience, and relevant education and/or training. This role may also be eligible for discretionary bonuses, equity, and/or commissions, as well as benefits.

Salary Range

$153,750—$230,625 USD

Where we Work

We are embracing an office-first culture, encouraging three days a week in office for most roles, with meaningful opportunities to collaborate and celebrate in person.

Each role may have specific requirements or flexibility depending on the scope of the position, so we encourage you to verify this with your recruiter during your first interview.

Benefits

As an employee at OneTrust, you will be part of the OneTeam. That means you’ll receive support physically, mentally, and emotionally so that you can do your best work both in and out of the office. This includes comprehensive healthcare coverage, flexible PTO, equity RSUs, annual performance bonus opportunities, retirement account support, 14+ weeks of paid parental leave, career development opportunities, company-paid privacy certification exam fees, and much more. Specific benefits differ by country. For more information, talk to your recruiter or visit onetrust.com/careers.

Resources

Check out the following to learn more about OneTrust and its people:

OneTrust Careers on YouTube
@LifeatOneTrust on Instagram

Your Data

You have the right to have your personal data updated or removed. You also have the right to have a copy of the information OneTrust holds about you. Further details about these rights are available on the website in our Privacy Overview .
You can change your mind at any time and have your personal data removed from our database. In order to do this you must contact us and let us know you wish to be removed. The request should be made on the Data Subject Request Form.

Recruitment fraud warning: OneTrust is aware of scams involving false offers of employment with our company. The fraudulent jobs, interviews and job offers use fake websites, email addresses, group chat and text messages. Be aware that we never ask candidates for personal information, IDs or bank information during the interview process. We do not interview prospective candidates via instant message or group chat, and do not require candidates to purchase products or services, or process payments on our behalf as a condition of any employment offer. Please note that any legitimate interview availability requests will come directly from a OneTrust recruiter with an "@onetrust.com" email address. You may also receive legitimate emails from "@us.greenhouse-mail.io". Recruiters will only reach out to candidates who have applied for a role through our ATS (Greenhouse) or prospects via LinkedIn InMail. Job offers will come from a recruiter and may have a "@docusign.net" email address. For more information or if you have been targeted please reach out to askrecruiting@onetrust.com.

Our Commitment to You

When you join OneTrust you are stepping onto a launching pad — the countdown has begun. The destination? A career without boundaries working alongside a diverse and inclusive crew who is passionate about doing meaningful work. As a pioneer, your voice and expertise will help chart the direction of an entirely new category. Our commitment to putting people first starts with you. Your growth is part of the mission. Our goal is to give you the power to embark on the next phase of your uniquely, unique career.
