jobs.description:
*Please note we are hiring for this role remote anywhere in the United States*

A Little About Us

EDB provides a data and AI platform that enables organizations to harness the full power of Postgres for transactional, analytical, and AI workloads across any cloud, anywhere. EDB empowers enterprises to control risk, manage costs and scale efficiently for a data and AI led world. Serving more than 1,500 customers globally and as the leading contributor to the vibrant and fast-growing PostgreSQL community, EDB supports major government organizations, financial services, media and information technology companies. EDB’s data-driven solutions enable customers to modernize legacy systems and break data silos while leveraging enterprise-grade open source technologies. EDB delivers the confidence of up to 99.999% high availability with mission critical capabilities built in such as security, compliance controls, and observability. For more information, visit www.enterprisedb.com

The Role

You'll lead Security Operations and Security Engineering at EDB, reporting to the CISO as a trusted member of the security leadership team. You own how we detect, respond, and (increasingly) prevent. That means the people, the platforms, and the playbooks behind threat detection, incident response, and the engineering that makes them scale.

You'll be a peer to the leaders across security, including Governance, Risk & Compliance and Application Security & Vulnerability Management, and you'll help shape the direction of the broader InfoSec organization. You'll also partner closely with peer leaders in IT and Product, because most of the controls we define live in their systems, pipelines, and roadmaps. This is a scaling role. The business is growing fast, and so is everything security has to cover: more products, more cloud, more acquired companies and environments to bring up to a common standard. You'll decide what to build, what to automate, and where to add people, so the program grows ahead of the risk instead of behind it. As EDB grows, so will the scope and opportunity of the role.

One leader owns both Security Operations and Security Engineering on purpose: the best incident is the one that never happens. What we learn from detection and response feeds directly into the engineering of preventive controls, so we move from detecting bad things to making them impossible, and from manual triage to automation and agents that give analysts leverage. If you want to build that, and grow a program and a team as the company grows, this is the seat.

What Your Impact Will Be

Incident response end to end, from intake and severity model through after-action and improvement, including partnership with Legal on investigations
Detection engineering, threat hunting, and the SIEM, EDR, SOAR, and cloud security platforms that support them
Security Engineering strategy and delivery, with the goal of preventing incidents rather than responding to them: preventive controls, least privilege, and identity assurance across employees, contractors, and build systems
The insider threat program, built with HR, Legal, and IT
Automation and agentic AI that extends analyst capacity (the analyst always owns the decision)
Security integration of acquired companies and new environments into EDB's standards
Close partnership with IT and Product leadership to build preventive controls into the platforms, pipelines, and products they own, plus security input to third-party risk and device posture with GRC
Scaling the program: the org design, operating rhythms, roadmap, budget, and vendor strategy that let coverage grow with the business without growing linearly with headcount

What You Will Bring

5+ years of management experience leading security teams
7+ years of hands-on experience in security operations, incident response, detection, or security engineering
A track record of scaling a security function through rapid growth (hiring, automation, and operating discipline), not just running one
Strategic thinking that goes beyond the immediate scope of the role
The ability to translate technical risk into business impact for executives, legal, customers, and your IT and Product counterparts
Comfort in a global, remote-first environment with flexible schedules and on-call responsibilities

What Will Give You An Edge

Hands-on scripting or automation experience (Python, Go, etc.)
Experience applying AI or agent-based automation to security workflows
Cloud security experience and background in M&A security integration
Experience building an insider threat or identity assurance program

We provide access to CuraLinc to aid employees in health and wellness tips and practices, as well as Wellness Fridays extending to December 2026! Check out our career site for more information on perks and benefits and reach out to our Talent Acquisition team for region specific benefits.

We know it takes a unique mix of people and skills to help us in our mission to supercharge Postgres, and we understand that not everyone will check every box. We’d love to hear from you and we want you to apply!

Position Overview

The Vice President of Engineering leads AVT Simulation’s enterprise engineering organization and is accountable for disciplined, predictable technical execution across hardware, software, systems engineering, integration, configuration, and related technical disciplines. The role establishes common standards across programs and ensures engineering outputs are complete, controlled, manufacturable, testable, and delivered in time to support customer and program commitments.

This leader will strengthen horizontal engineering management, improve visibility to capacity and technical risk, and help AVT scale from complex systems integration into a greater level of repeatable manufacturing.

Key Responsibilities/Duties/Functions/Tasks

Enterprise Engineering Leadership

Lead the technical transformation of AVT from a program-based systems integrator to a mid-market OEM, focused on establishing product lines supported by centralized Engineering.
Lead the centralized multidisciplinary engineering organization, establishing common standards, operating cadence, technical governance, decision rights, and technical performance expectations across programs.
Directly manage and mentor the Engineering Directors (Enterprise Solutions Architect, Integrated Systems Engineering, and Software Engineering) to ensure functional depth and enterprise-wide technical governance.
Implement and oversee the Centralized Design Authority with Product Line Alignment model, providing horizontal leadership to resolve technical risk, architecture decisions, resource conflicts, and cross-functional barriers through dotted-line Chief Engineer assignments.
Partner with the Enterprise Solutions Architect / Technical Authority to govern technical decisions across all product families, protecting design authority and product qualification discipline.
Build a culture of technical rigor, accountability, collaboration, and early escalation, with strong synchronization with Program Management, Supply Chain, Manufacturing, Quality, and Test.
Lead the development and maintenance of engineering processes, policies, and standards ensuring compliance with ISO and CMMI objectives, and driving achievement and ongoing management of Cybersecurity Maturity Model Certification (CMMC) Level 2.

Engineering Execution & Program Health

Own engineering performance against program schedules, drawing and software releases, design reviews, integration needs, and customer milestones.
Maintain one trusted source of engineering status and provide clear program health KPIs, including technical risk assessments, with cause, impact, owner, recovery action, and date for at-risk conditions.
Use leading indicators and a disciplined review cadence to identify and recover technical blockers before they affect schedule, cost, quality, margin, or customer delivery.

Product Development, Requirements & Configuration

Own and continuously improve AVT’s engineering portions of the product-development lifecycle, simplifying unnecessary complexity while preserving critical controls.
Ensure practical gate and review criteria for requirements, PDR/CDR, design readiness, production readiness, test readiness, technical release, product support including technical refresh cycles.
Maintain requirements traceability, configuration integrity, and disciplined control of ECRs, ECNs, software defects, redlines, and major technical decisions.
Strengthen the transition from engineering development into procurement, manufacturing, integration, test, and repeatable production.
Serve as the enterprise Technology Control Officer (TCO), providing executive oversight of the Technology Control Plan (TCP) to ensure rigorous compliance with ITAR and Export Control regulations governing the protection and handling of technical data for sensitive technology transfers and “deemed exports”.

Resource, Talent & PMO

Maintain an enterprise view of engineering demand, capacity, critical skills, and future needs; resolve cross-program resource conflicts before commitments are affected.
Partner with HR on critical technical recruiting, succession, onboarding, cross-training, and backup coverage to preserve and grow expertise across systems, mechanical, electrical, software, test, configuration management, and manufacturing engineering — reducing skill gaps, single-person dependencies, and ensuring the functional depth.
Partner with Program Management and the PMO to integrate engineering commitments, resources, dependencies, and risks into program plans, and engage early in proposals to validate technical feasibility, schedule realism, manufacturability, capacity, cost realism, and program risk.

Proposal & Partnerships

Drive engineering support for new business capture, ensuring technical inputs for RFIs, RFPs, and white papers are accurate, compelling, and aligned with AVT’s product-based strategy.
Direct the engineering Bid & Proposal process to ensure proposed solutions are technically compliant, competitively priced, and backed by realistic resource estimates and schedules.
Lead the functional and technical management of Internal R&D (IRAD), conceiving and executing projects that deepen the company's understanding of critical requirements and technologies to improve proposal win rates, while overseeing the development and demonstration of AVT's internally-developed product lines.
Collaborate on Business Development initiatives and engage with prospective teaming partners to evaluate technical synergies and expand AVT’s market reach.

Key Engineering Measures

Drawing and software release adherence; critical technical backlog and aging.
ECR/ECN aging, stalled approvals, unresolved technical decisions, critical defects, and configuration integrity.
Engineering capacity and skill coverage, technical gate readiness, engineering-driven manufacturing holds, and downstream milestones at risk.
Engineering contribution to on-time customer delivery, quality, program margin, and customer confidence.

Other Duties

Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee for the job. Duties, responsibilities and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

Qualifications & Experience

Minimum Requirements

15+ years of progressive engineering experience in aerospace, defense, training simulations, advanced manufacturing, complex engineered products, or a comparable technical environment.
Proven (5+ years) leadership experience managing multidisciplinary engineering organizations across hardware, software, systems, integration, or complex product development.
Demonstrated success establishing engineering standards, governance, metrics, resource discipline, and accountability across multiple programs.
Strong understanding of requirements, configuration management, engineering change control, technical reviews, release processes, and manufacturing/test readiness, with a track record of improving schedule and delivery predictability.
Relevant Experience in OEM environments, particularly in scaling engineering operations for repeatable product manufacturing.
Experience transitioning products from development into low-volume/high-complexity and/or higher-volume manufacturing; familiarity with AS9100, ISO, CMMI, or structured stage-gate environments.

Preferred

Experience with flight simulation, defense systems, aviation, mission-critical engineered products, or U.S. Government programs.
Education
Bachelor of Science degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Systems Engineering, or a related technical discipline required; advanced technical or business degree preferred.

Leadership Attributes

Enterprise-minded and execution-oriented; manages Engineering for AVT’s success, not as an isolated function.
Technically credible, data-driven, transparent, and able to make timely technical, resource, priority, and people decisions.
Highly collaborative and capable of bridging Program Management, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Quality, Finance, Business Development, and customers.
Visible developer of talent who builds capability, accountability, succession, and continuous improvement.

Essential Physical RequirementsThe physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job.

jobs.description:
**This position is to work onboard

The Entertainment Technical Director (ETDC) is responsible for the overall maintenance, upkeep, safe operation, and training of the ship’s technical equipment. This includes all sound, lighting, performer flying, and stage automation systems.
The ETDC will be responsible for directly managing the Entertainment Operators & Staff, the overall maintenance and inventory of all entertainment venues, and safety inspections and quality control. The ETDC will create an environment that facilitates the needs of the Cruise Director and that inspires and supports the Entertainment Operators & Staff.

Note:

Employees may be required to perform any other job-related duties assigned by their supervisor or management. All duties and responsibilities are to be performed in accordance with the Company's Safety, Quality and Environmental standards.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

Create clear and concise maintenance and inspection schedules for Entertainment Operators and Staff in conjunction with the Stage & Production Manager and Venue Production Managers.
· Create clear and concise schedules for the Entertainment Staff & Operators. Schedules are to be communicated and distributed to team members in a timely fashion.
· Creates technical reports (EOV & Deficiency Reports) on all technical equipment and technical staff each voyage.
· Liaise with Cruise Director, Stage & Production Manager, and Venue Production Manager to schedule and coordinate all maintenance calls for the ship’s lighting, sound, performer flying and stage automation systems.
· Attend and support Key A’ Driver events throughout the ship as needed by the Cruise Director, Stage & Production Manager or Venue Production Manager.
· Responsible for the supervision and performance management of the Entertainment Operators and Entertainment Staff. Will converse with the Venue Production Managers and Stage & Production Manager to input performance appraisal and disciplinary actions for Operators & Staff.
· Responsible for receiving and communicating important information from shipboard leadership and policies to the Entertainment Staff by holding regular staff meetings and other means of clear communication.
· Responsible for operating the stage automation system and performer flying system in the Celebrity Theatre for rehearsals and performances. Responsible for training and rehearsing the Stage & Production Manager on being the secondary automation/rigging operator.
· Responsible for the upkeep, repair, maintenance, and inspections for all entertainment technical equipment.
· Responsible for ensuring the Entertainment Operators are correctly using and operating technical equipment during rehearsals and performances. Will ensure all Operators are scheduled to cross train with other operators to learn all shows during rehearsal times in the main theatre so there are backups for each position should the need arise.
· Communicate clearly with head office any issues, problems, concerns that may arise in daily operations.
· Ensures music and lighting in all venues is aesthetically pleasing and appropriate by carrying out regular ship wide walks in addition to the AV on duty alongside the Venue Production Manager and Stage & Production Manager.
· Oversees with Entertainment Operator Fly the safe use of aerial and automation systems in the Celebrity Theatre and the alternative entertainment venues ensuring only produced/approved material and equipment is utilized.
· Supervise stage resets alongside the Cast and AV team to ensure scenery, props and equipment are set up/struck at appropriate times in the Celebrity Theatre and entertainment venues.
· Liaise with ship-wide department managers and supervisors to fulfill tech requests through the tech request process.
· Liaise with the Cruise Director, Stage & Production Manager, Venue Production Managers, Broadcast Manager, and other department heads on a regular basis.
· Jointly responsible (with the Stage & Production Manager) for all entertainment technical facilities including backstage, dressing rooms, quick changes, AV lockers and stores, wardrobe facilities, etc. Will ensure all areas are kept clean and tidy by Cast and AV members, that all shipboard Safety and SQM policies are met, and report maintenance issues through IssueTrax as needed.
· Work closely with the Entertainment Operators to ensure all Celebrity Theatre equipment is maintained and inspected accordingly (Deficiency Report to be submitted to head office as required). Assign maintenance and upkeep tasks to Entertainment Operators and Staff on a regular basis - create IssueTrax's as reqired and assign maintenance and upkeep tasks to Entertainment Operators and Staff as necessary.
· Work closely and communicate with the Venue Production Manager and Entertainment Operators to ensure all alternative entertainment venue equipment is in good working order – create IssueTrax's as reqired and assign maintenance and upkeep tasks to Entertainment Operators and Staff as necessary.
· Administrative tasks which should include (but is not limited to):
o Creating daily schedules for the Entertainment Operators and Staff.
o Creating and updating equipment reports (EOV’s and Deficiency Report).
o Update and monitor effective time keeping (Kronos) for Entertainment Operators and Staff.
o Create and input disciplinary actions and appraisals for the Entertainment Operators and Staff.
o Process and schedule technical requests.
o Create Fleet Visitor requests for technical vendors, crew visitors, and others as required.
o Work closely and communicate with the Venue Production Manager and Stage & Production Manager to ensure the Audio Visual and Entertainment team have the required resources to complete their jobs – create Crunch Time orders as required.
o Updating OCIMS with safety observations as required.

QUALIFICATIONS

· A bachelor’s degree in entertainment or theatrical management (stage, technical or production) from an accredited university or equivalent experience is required.
· Minimum 4 years’ experience in entertainment technical management.
· Experience with multi-unit management in entertainment back of house.
· Advanced operation, maintenance and technical knowledge of varied lighting, sound, rigging, and automation systems required.
· Experience with stage automation and entertainment rigging. Basic knowledge of mechanical and electrical engineering, components, and system design.
· Proficient in MS Office Suite.
· Outstanding communication and interpersonal skills.
· Ability to work positively and cooperatively in a diverse team environment to meet overall established timeframes.
· Ability to communicate tactfully with department heads, coworkers, and other shipboard employees to resolve problems and negotiate resolutions.
· Able to interpret a variety of instructions furnished in written, oral, diagram or schedule form.
· High level of ability to successfully accomplish several tasks under pressure and fixed time constraints.
· Working knowledge of computers, Internet access, and the ability to navigate within a variety of software packages such as Excel, Word, or related programs.
· Previous cruise line experience a plus.

Language Requirements

Ability to speak English clearly, distinctly and cordially with guests and crew members.
Ability to read and write English in order to understand and interpret written procedures. This includes the ability to give and receive instructions in written and verbal forms and to effectively present information and respond to questions from guests, supervisors and co-workers.

Physical Requirements

While performing the duties of this job, the shipboard employee is regularly required to stand; walk; use hands to touch, handle, or feel; reach with hands and arms; talk or hear; and taste or smell. The employee must continually lift and/or move up to 50 pounds and may work at heights up to 50 feet. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception and ability to adjust focus.
All shipboard employees must be physically able to participate in emergency lifesaving procedures and drills. Full use and range of arms and legs as well as full visual, verbal and hearing abilities are required to receive and give instructions in the event of an emergency including the lowering of lifeboats.

Research to Production: Successfully transition breakthrough ML research into production-ready systems that directly impact core company metrics.

Technical Depth: 7+ years of combined post-graduate academic and industry experience applying state-of-the-art ML technologies to real-world problems on web-scale data, alongside 3+ years of direct people management experience.

Business & Product Acumen: The ability to transform vague, ambiguous questions into well-defined projects with clear success metrics that drive business decisions.

jobs.title: Sr. Manager, Data Engineering - SAP
jobs.description:
Job Overview

The Senior Manager Data Engineering – SAP will own the buildout and ongoing delivery of UNFI’s SAP Business Data Cloud capability, establishing the environment, delivery model, governance structure, and roadmap needed to support SAP-enabled analytics, reporting, data products, and AI use cases. This role is accountable for turning SAP BDC, SAP Datasphere, SAP Analytics Cloud, and related integration patterns into a scalable enterprise capability that improves access to trusted business data while supporting UNFI’s broader SAP transformation. The ideal candidate combines strong SAP data and analytics experience with hands-on program leadership, partner governance, and the ability to align business, technology, and delivery teams around clear outcomes.

Job Responsibilities

Own SAP Business Data Cloud Buildout and Enterprise Data Capability

Own the SAP Business Data Cloud environment buildout, delivery roadmap, data product model, platform standards, and operating practices needed to support UNFI’s SAP transformation.
Establish strategy and delivery plans across SAP Business Data Cloud, SAP Datasphere, SAP Analytics Cloud, enterprise reporting, semantic models, and downstream data integrations.
Drive the transition from legacy reporting, extracts, and data feeds to governed SAP BDC-enabled data products and analytics capabilities.
Define standards for data product lifecycle management, semantic modeling, consumption patterns, data quality, lineage, access, and production support.
Ensure business continuity as UNFI retires legacy platforms and moves to scalable SAP-based data and analytics capabilities.
Collaborate with SAP Program Leadership, Enterprise Applications, Data Architecture, Data Engineering, Data Platform, Analytics and BI, and Data Product teams to align delivery plans, architecture decisions, and technical standards.

Govern Consulting Partners

Responsible for overseeing external partners supporting SAP BDC, reporting, integration, and data product delivery.
Hold delivery partners accountable for scope, timelines, budgets, quality, risks, and measurable business outcomes.
Review delivery plans, milestones, staffing models, technical approaches, and execution strategies across multiple workstreams.
Support executive governance reviews by providing delivery status, risks, decisions, and recommendations.
Govern multi-partner delivery models by defining clear scope boundaries, handoffs, accountabilities, and escalation paths across platform, modeling, reporting, and data feed workstreams.

Build and Lead High-Performing Teams

Build and manage a blended team of UNFI associates, consultants, contractors, and offshore delivery resources.
Build internal SAP BDC, Datasphere, SAC, and data product delivery capability to reduce long-term dependency on external partners.
Establish clear accountability, delivery processes, operating models, and performance expectations across internal and partner resources.
Mentor and develop internal talent while building sustainable organizational capability for SAP data, analytics, and reporting modernization.

Establish Governance and Operating Excellence

Create governance frameworks that drive transparency, accountability, and predictable delivery outcomes across SAP BDC, Datasphere, SAC, reporting, and integration workstreams.
Define portfolio prioritization processes, intake mechanisms, roadmap management practices, release planning, and delivery standards.
Establish standards for environment readiness, access and security governance, data quality, lineage, metadata, test readiness, production support, and sustainment.
Manage assigned budgets, resource plans, vendor capacity, and forecasts for SAP BDC delivery workstreams.
Drive executive reporting, KPI measurement, risk management, dependency tracking, and transformation success metrics.
Protect program scope boundaries against adjacent or overlapping enterprise initiatives, ensuring SAP BDC responsibilities, dependencies, and handoffs remain clearly defined.

Support Business Readiness and Adoption

Partner with OCM, SAP program, and business leaders to support communications, training, readiness planning, and adoption tracking for users transitioning from legacy reports, feeds, and extracts.
Ensure SAP BDC, SAC, reporting, and data product releases include clear adoption plans, user impacts, support models, and cutover readiness checkpoints.
Provide input into training and communications based on delivery scope, release timing, data availability, and business process impacts.
Track delivery, adoption, quality, and operational metrics for SAP BDC-related capabilities.

Education/Certifications

Job Requirements:

Bachelor’s degree in business, technology, engineering, computer science, data science, information systems, operations, supply chain, finance, or a related field.

Required Experience

10+ years of progressive experience in data and analytics, data engineering, enterprise reporting, data warehousing, business intelligence, or enterprise data platforms.
5+ years leading SAP data, analytics, reporting, or integration initiatives, with experience in SAP Datasphere, SAP Analytics Cloud, BW/4HANA, HANA, S/4HANA analytics.
Experience standing up, scaling, or modernizing enterprise data, analytics, reporting, or platform capabilities, including operating model, delivery standards, governance, and support practices.
Demonstrated experience governing consulting partners and system integrators, including scope management, delivery accountability, budget oversight, escalation management, and quality assurance.
Proven success leading cross-functional teams and blended delivery models across internal associates, consultants, contractors, and offshore resources.
Experience delivering complex programs involving enterprise reporting, analytics modernization, data integration, semantic modeling, data products, or cloud data platforms.
Demonstrated experience leading formal Organizational Change Management efforts, including training, communications, readiness planning, and adoption tracking for enterprise system transitions.

Preferred Experience

Background in retail, grocery, distribution, logistics, warehouse operations, supply chain, or wholesale industries.
Professional certifications in program management, SAP, Agile, product management, or cloud technologies.

Knowledge/Skills/Abilities

Strong understanding of SAP Business Data Cloud, SAP Datasphere, SAP Analytics Cloud, and SAP-based reporting architecture; direct SAP BDC experience preferred.
Ability to define and govern standards for data products, semantic models, data quality, lineage, access controls, metadata, consumption patterns, and production support.
Working knowledge of SAP and enterprise integration patterns, including CDS views, Change Data Capture, APIs, ETL/ELT, and governed data product delivery.
Experience with modern cloud data platforms.
Strong program leadership skills, including roadmap management, prioritization, financial stewardship, partner governance, risk management, and executive communication.
Ability to translate business reporting, analytics, and data consumption needs into clear delivery scope, sequencing, adoption plans, and measurable outcomes.
Excellent communication, negotiation, and influence skills, with the ability to align business, technology, and partner teams around shared outcomes.
Good judgment, sound escalation practices, and adherence to established procedures are required; the role generally operates with close supervision by management and senior team members.

Work Environment

Remote Role:

This position is classified as remote where the associate will perform remote work from their primary residence. Remote associates are welcome to work from the office but are not required to do so. While remote associates are not required to work from an office on a regular basis, they may be required to come to the office or other UNFI locations for necessary business reasons or if directed to do so by their manager.

Physical Environment/Demands

This role is meant to be primarily remote, with some presence expected in office ad-hoc as required. For office environments:

Most work is performed in a temperature-controlled office environment.
Incumbent may sit for long periods of time at a desk or computer terminal.
While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to sit; use hands to finger, handle, or feel; reach with hands and arms; and talk or hear.

Stooping, bending, twisting, and reaching may be required in the completion of job duties.

jobs.title: Director, Global Solutions Engineering
jobs.description:
Who are we?

At UpGuard, we are replacing manual security bottlenecks with AI-driven precision. Fresh off a US$75M Series C, we are scaling our infrastructure to process 100 billion risk signals daily. This isn’t just growth; it’s a total reimagining of how the world manages cyber risk.

We build the Cyber Risk Posture Management (CRPM) platform that security teams actually love. By integrating security ratings, threat intel, and agentic AI, we empower organisations to stay ahead of an ever evolving attack surface.

We aren’t just building another tool; we’re defining a category. We provide the autonomy to ship world-class technology and the resources to do it at a global scale.

Why are we hiring for this role?

We're hiring a Director of Global Solutions Engineering
to lead the technical engine behind our revenue organization. As a cybersecurity company, our technical credibility is central to how we win and keep customers — and this leader owns it across the customer journey. You'll run a global, two-part function as a manager of managers: Sales Engineers
who drive the technical win in new business (pre-sales), and Solutions Consultants
who serve as the technical escalation path for our post-sales teams. You'll report directly to the CRO.

This is a builder's role for a leader who is equally comfortable in a strategy conversation with the executive team, in a technical deep-dive with an engineer, and jumping into a live customer call to lead it when it counts. Details of the remit are below.

Please note that we are only considering candidates who are in the PST time zone or Australia for this role.

What will you do?

Lead a global, multi-layered team. Manage and develop distributed managers and their teams of Sales Engineers and Solutions Consultants across regions. Hire, coach, and retain top technical talent; set clear career paths; and build a culture of technical excellence, curiosity, and customer obsession.
Own the technical win in pre-sales. Lead the Sales Engineering team to drive pipeline conversion through world-class demos, proofs of concept, technical discovery, and value engineering — consistently earning the technical decision.
Own the post-sales technical escalation path. Lead the Solutions Consultants team as the technical escalation path for CSMs and the driver of technical cross-sell across our product suite. (Note: with a dedicated Professional Services team being stood up, Solutions Consultants are not expected to own customer onboarding today — though this scope may evolve.)
Stay hands-on when it counts. Be willing and able to personally jump into a high-stakes customer call and lead it — you set the technical bar by example, not just from the org chart.
Elevate RFPs and security assessments. Build a scalable, high-quality function for RFPs, security questionnaires, and technical/security assessments — improving accuracy, consistency, and turnaround, and building reusable content that raises win rates.
Enable and scale the channel. Technically enable partners — training, certification, demo readiness, and deal support — so they can independently represent and implement our product.
Partner with Enablement. Work with Sales Enablement to design and deliver technical training, certification, demo standards, and competitive playbooks that keep the team and the wider revenue org sharp.
Be the voice of the customer to Product. Capture field and technical feedback and channel it to Product and Engineering to influence the roadmap.
Operate as a revenue leader. Contribute to forecasting, capacity planning, and go-to-market strategy with the CRO and revenue leadership team, and define the metrics and processes that make the function measurable and scalable.

What will you bring?

We care far more about your track record than your tenure. The bar is a leader who has built and run a world-class technical team serving technical customers with a technical product.
A demonstrated track record of building and leading a world-class Solutions/Sales Engineering team — you've raised the technical bar of an organization, not just managed headcount.
Experience selling and supporting a genuinely technical product to technical buyers and evaluators (engineers, security teams, architects). Cybersecurity or security/GRC experience is strongly preferred; adjacent deeply-technical domains considered.
Proven experience as a manager of managers leading distributed or global teams across multiple time zones.
Ownership of the technical experience across the customer journey — from the technical win in new business through post-sales technical support and cross-sell.
A hands-on disposition — you're credible and willing in the room, able to step into and lead a high-stakes customer call yourself.
A track record of building or scaling RFP / security assessment functions and lifting win rates through repeatable process and reusable content.
Experience technically enabling channel / partner ecosystems so partners can represent and implement the product independently.
A strong partnership orientation — you've worked shoulder-to-shoulder with Sales, Customer Success, Product, and Enablement.
Excellent executive communication skills; equally credible with C-level buyers and hands-on technical evaluators.
Comfort operating in a fast-paced, high-growth, remote-first environment.

What's in it for you?

Monthly Lifestyle subsidy: Use this for financial, physical, and mental well-being
WFH set-up allowance: To ensure you have the right environment to work in, we will help you get set up within your first 3 months at UpGuard
$1500 USD annual Learning & Development allowance: To support your career development, all team members will be able to expense development opportunities against this allowance
Annual leave: PTO plus two additional UpGuardian leave days to give you time to recharge your batteries.
18 weeks paid Parental Leave: Irrespective of parenting role
Personal Leave Allowance: This includes sick & carer’s leave
Fully remote working environment: While we have physical offices in Sydney & Hobart, we do not mandate compulsory attendance
Top-spec hardware: All team members will be provided with top-spec laptops for their role
Generative AI subsidy: UpGuard provides paid subscriptions for all team members to access generative AI tools to support their work
Health Insurance: Access to comprehensive coverage.
Stock Options: Share in UpGuard's growth and long-term success.

jobs.title: Senior Director, Data Science
jobs.description:
Data is at the center of everything we do. As a startup, we disrupted the credit card industry by individually personalizing every credit card offer using statistical modeling and the relational database, cutting edge technology in 1988! Fast-forward a few years, and this little innovation and our passion for data has skyrocketed us to a Fortune 200 company and a leader in the world of data-driven decision-making.

As a Data Science Leader at Capital One, you’ll be part of a team that’s leading the next wave of disruption at a whole new scale, using the latest in computing and machine learning technologies and operating across billions of customer records to unlock the big opportunities that help everyday people save money, time and agony in their financial lives.

About The Team

We're building a portfolio of agentic AI products to transform Capital One's engineering organizations and lines of business – autonomous coding agents, context engineering, and agentic model-development lifecycle to name a few. We're creating a new science team to help define the long-term strategy, analyze & optimize impact throughout the ecosystem, and drive business value at enterprise scale. As a scientist on the team, you'd design AI/ML models and help build the solutions behind these products. You'd also own the science that guides them: designing experiments (A/B tests), modeling telemetry, and turning the results into AI strategy and guidance for C-suite leadership.

In this role, you will:

Partner with a cross-functional team of software engineers, distinguished researchers, and solutions architects to drive great decisions through modeling
Define and drive towards an end state that is based on simplicity and the adoption of digital technologies, cloud hosting, and open source software.
Distill the details of complex interconnected modeling systems to influence senior business leaders on model strategy, business use, and risks
Assess, challenge, and at times defend state-of-the-art decision-making systems to internal and regulatory partners
Shape our practice of building machine learning models, from design through training, evaluation, validation, and implementation
Oversee development of benchmark and challenger models to stress test critical modeling decisions

The Ideal Candidate is:

A leader. You challenge conventional thinking and work with stakeholders to identify and improve the status quo.
Creative. You thrive on bringing definition to big, undefined problems. You love asking questions and pushing hard to find answers. You’re not afraid to share a new idea.
Technical. You’re comfortable with open-source languages and are passionate about developing further. You have hands-on experience developing data science solutions using open-source tools and cloud computing platforms.
Statistically-minded. You’ve built models, validated them, and backtested them. You know how to interpret a confusion matrix or a ROC curve. You have experience with clustering, classification, sentiment analysis, time series, and deep learning.

Basic Qualifications:

Currently has, or is in the process of obtaining one of the following with an expectation that the required degree will be obtained on or before the scheduled start date :
A Bachelor's Degree in a quantitative field (Statistics, Economics, Operations Research, Analytics, Mathematics, Computer Science, or a related quantitative field) plus 11 years of experience performing data analytics
A Master's Degree in a quantitative field (Statistics, Economics, Operations Research, Analytics, Mathematics, Computer Science, or a related quantitative field) or an MBA with a quantitative concentration plus 9 years of experience performing data analytics
A PHD in a quantitative field (Statistics, Economics, Operations Research, Analytics, Mathematics, Computer Science, or a related quantitative field) plus 6 years of experience performing data analytics

At least 6 years of experience leveraging open source programming languages for large scale data analysis
At least 6 years of experience working with machine learning
At least 6 years of experience utilizing relational databases

Preferred Qualifications:

PhD in “STEM” field (Science, Technology, Engineering, or Mathematics) plus 5 years of experience in data analytics
At least 6 years of experience in Python, Scala, or R for large scale data analysis
At least 6 years of experience with machine learning
At least 2 year of experience working with AWS
At least 6 years of experience with complex architectural patterns (SOA), building APIs, microservices, and event streams
At least 6 years of experience with DevOps or DevSecOps and building CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins, Artifactory, Chef, Ansible, AWS CloudFormation templates, GitHub, and Sonar

Human Centered - Obsesses about internal and external customer needs to reimagine and innovate product solutions
Business Focused - Delivers game-changing outcomes by focusing on leverage and execution excellence

jobs.description:
JOB DESCRIPTION

Senior Vice President AI/ML Software Engineer

At BNY, our culture allows us to run our company better and enables employees’ growth and success. As a leading global financial services company at the heart of the global financial system, we influence nearly 20% of the world’s investible assets. Every day, our teams harness cutting-edge AI and breakthrough technologies to collaborate with clients, driving transformative solutions that redefine industries and uplift communities worldwide.

Recognized as a top destination for innovators and champions of inclusion, BNY is where bold ideas meet advanced technology and exceptional talent. Together, we power the future of finance – and this is what is all about. Join us and be part of something extraordinary.

We’re seeking a future team member for the role of Senior Vice President AI/ML Software Engineer
to lead the architecture and delivery of production-grade AI systems built on agentic frameworks, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and LLM orchestration. This is a hands-on technical leadership role responsible for a team of engineers building autonomous AI pipelines that extract, validate, and reason over complex unstructured documents. You will own the technical vision for a multi-agent ecosystem -- designing pipeline orchestration engines, embedding/vectorization strategies, knowledge retrieval systems, and AI-assisted code generation tooling. You will lead a VP-level engineer and a broader team of 4-8 developers. This role is in New York, NY

What Sets This Role Apart
- You build the agent framework, not just configure one -- custom orchestration engine, not a LangChain wrapper - Production AI with real consequences -- extraction accuracy directly impacts financial operations - Full RAG ownership -- from raw OCR bytes through embedding, retrieval, and generation - Evaluation-driven culture -- golden-truth datasets, automated regression, measurable quality gates - Greenfield AI + enterprise integration -- build new AI-native systems that plug into established platforms

In this role, you'll have the opportunity to impact on our organization in the following ways:

Technical Leadership & Architecture

Architect agentic AI systems: multi-agent orchestration, tool-use patterns, planning/reasoning loops, and autonomous decision chains - Design and evolve RAG infrastructure -- chunking strategies, embedding pipelines, vector store selection, retrieval ranking, and context window optimization - Define vectorization strategy: embedding model selection, dimensionality trade-offs, hybrid search (dense + sparse), and re-ranking approaches - Own the AI pipeline orchestration framework -- blocks, inlets/outlets, blackboards, memory stores, and content policy enforcement - Make build-vs-buy decisions across the AI toolchain (vector databases, agent frameworks, evaluation harnesses, model gateways) - Establish patterns for prompt engineering at scale: prompt versioning, chain-of-thought decomposition, few-shot management, and guardrails

Agentic & RAG Systems

Design multi-agent architectures with shared memory, blackboard patterns, and inter-agent communication protocols - Build autonomous extraction agents capable of planning, tool selection, self-correction, and validation - Implement knowledge graph construction from unstructured documents -- entity extraction, relationship mapping, and graph-based retrieval - Develop evaluation frameworks: retrieval precision/recall, extraction accuracy, agent task completion rates, and hallucination detection - Design feedback loops: human-in-the-loop correction, reinforcement from golden-truth datasets, and continuous prompt refinement

Team Leadership

Lead, mentor, and grow a team of 4-8 engineers (AI/ML, backend, full-stack) - Directly manage a VP-level AI engineer; provide technical guidance and career development - Drive architecture reviews, design sessions, and technical decision-making - Own sprint planning, technical backlog, and delivery commitments - Foster a culture of rapid experimentation balanced with production rigor

Hands-On Engineering -

Implement core agentic components: agent loops, tool registries, memory persistence, and reasoning traces - Build embedding pipelines -- document preprocessing, chunk boundary detection, metadata enrichment, and vector index management - Develop scoring and validation systems (Bayesian confidence, cross-agent consensus, golden-truth comparison) - Contribute to platform services (Java/Spring Boot) and AI service layer (Python/FastAPI) - Build AI-assisted developer tooling: code generation workflows, automated test generation, and intelligent code review

Delivery & Operations

Own CI/CD pipelines, containerized deployments, and environment promotion - Define observability: agent execution traces, token usage tracking, retrieval quality metrics, and pipeline telemetry - Manage schema evolution and data stores (relational + vector) - Coordinate cross-team dependencies with platform engineering, data engineering, and infrastructure

To be successful in this role, we’re seeking the following:

Bachelor's degree or Advanced degree in computer science engineering or a related discipline, or equivalent work experience required. 10+ years of professional software engineering experience - 3+ years leading or technically mentoring engineering teams - Deep expertise in AI/ML systems: - LLM orchestration, prompt engineering, chain-of-thought reasoning - RAG architectures: chunking, embedding, retrieval, re-ranking, context assembly - Agentic patterns: ReAct, tool-use, planning loops, multi-agent coordination - Vector databases and embedding models (OpenAI embeddings, sentence-transformers, FAISS, Pinecone, Weaviate, or similar) - Strong Python (3.11+): FastAPI, async/await, Poetry, Pydantic, pytest - Solid Java experience: Java 21, Spring Boot 3.x, microservice architecture - Production AI delivery: not just prototypes -- systems handling real workloads with observability, error recovery, and audit trails - Document intelligence: OCR pipelines, NLP, structured extraction from unstructured text - Testing & evaluation: golden-truth validation, retrieval metrics (MRR, NDCG), extraction F1 scores, agent success rates - Enterprise architecture: API design, circuit breakers, caching, event-driven patterns

Preferred Qualifications

Experience building custom agent frameworks (not just using LangChain/CrewAI out-of-the-box) - Knowledge of graph-based retrieval -- knowledge graphs, graph RAG, entity-relationship extraction - Experience with code AI: AI-assisted development tools, code generation pipelines, automated refactoring - Familiarity with model fine-tuning, LoRA/QLoRA, or RLHF techniques - Exposure to evaluation-driven development -- automated prompt regression testing, A/B testing of retrieval strategies - Angular/TypeScript experience for full-stack visibility - Capital markets or financial services domain knowledge - Familiarity with enterprise AI governance: content policies, PII handling, data residency

Technology Stack

AI/Agentic-
LLM orchestration, multi-agent systems, ReAct patterns, tool-use, autonomous pipelines

RAG & Vectors-
Embedding models, vector stores, hybrid search, re-ranking, chunk optimization

LLM-
Azure OpenAI, GPT-4o, enterprise model gateways, prompt versioning

Python-
Python 3.12/3.13, FastAPI, Poetry, Pydantic, async pipelines

Java-
Java 21, Spring Boot 3.x, Maven, Resilience4j, Hazelcast

Frontend-
Angular 19, TypeScript, D3.js, ECharts

Database-
Oracle, PostgreSQL, vector databases

Infrastructure-
Docker, GitLab CI/CD, Artifactory

Observability-
Agent traces, token tracking, retrieval quality metrics, audit pipelines

Be part of an amazing story

Macy’s is more than just a store. We’re a story. One that’s captured the hearts and minds of America for more than 160 years. A story about innovations and traditions…about inspiring stores and irresistible products…about the excitement of the Macy’s 4th of July Fireworks, and the wonder of the Thanksgiving Day Parade. We’ve been part of memorable moments and milestones for countless customers and colleagues. Those stories are part of what makes this such a special place to work.

Job Overview

The Director, Software Engineering reports to the Senior Director, Engineering and partners with them to establish and drive the technology solutions strategy and implementation to meet Macy’s business needs. The Director collaborates with technical and business functions across the enterprise, contributing to strategy and governance while making balanced technical decisions that consider code quality, delivery predictability, and, above all, business value.

The Director, Software Engineering maintains a strong engineering foundation with expertise in modern technology stacks and experience implementing contemporary technologies. This leader leverages managerial experience to guide and develop the existing engineering team, attract and recruit top engineering talent, and successfully lead large-scale technology implementations in retail or related industries.

What You Will Do

Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to drive platform modernization and enterprise-wide technology initiatives.
Enhance software quality across Macy’s Technology organization, driving end-to-end accountability at all levels.
Own talent development and build bench strength within the technology organization, ensuring a strong pipeline of skilled leaders and contributors.

About HighLevel:

HighLevel is an AI-powered business operating system that gives agencies, entrepreneurs and SMBs the infrastructure to build, automate and scale. Today, HighLevel supports SMBs across 150+ countries, fueling community-driven growth rooted in real customer outcomes.

To date, businesses operating on HighLevel have generated over $7 billion in ecosystem value, demonstrating the impact of shared infrastructure at scale. By centralizing conversations, automation and intelligence into one system, we help businesses move faster, reduce complexity and execute efficiently.

Behind the platform, HighLevel powers more than 4 billion API hits and 2.5 billion message events daily. With 250 terabytes of distributed data, 250+ microservices and over 1 million domain names supported, our architecture is built for performance, resilience and long-term scalability.

Our People

With over 2,000 team members across 10+ countries, HighLevel operates as a global, remote-first organization built for speed and ownership. We value initiative, clarity and execution, creating space for ambitious people to build systems that support millions of businesses worldwide. Here, innovation thrives, ideas are celebrated and people come first, no matter where they call home.

Our Impact

Every month, HighLevel enables more than 1.5 billion messages, 200 million leads and 20 million conversations for the more than 1 million businesses we support. Behind those numbers are real people building independence, expanding opportunity and creating measurable impact. We’re proud to be a part of that.

Learn more about us on our YouTube Channel or Blog Posts .

About the Role:

We are looking for a Senior Engineering Manager to lead our Data Platform & Infrastructure team. This leader will own the strategy, execution, and evolution of the foundational data systems that power insights and our ecosystem.

You will lead a team of highly capable engineers responsible for building reliable, scalable, secure, and developer-friendly data infrastructure. This includes data ingestion and processing, data platforms, storage and compute, orchestration, observability, and the infrastructure that enables teams across the company to efficiently build and operate data-intensive products and applications.

This is a hands-on leadership role: you will set technical direction and organizational strategy while remaining close enough to the technology to make high-quality architectural decisions and guide the team through complex technical challenges.

Responsibilities:

Leadership & Team Management

Lead, recruit, and mentor an exceptional engineering team.
Direct data infrastructure strategy to drive business and product success.
Oversee resource allocation, including headcount and vendor budget planning.
Establish operational rhythms, goals, and execution frameworks aligned with core business outcomes.
Cultivate an inclusive environment focused on ownership, technical rigor, and continuous professional development.
Champion team morale, engagement, learning opportunities, and delivery velocity.

Data Engineering Strategy

Guide system architecture, data flow design, quality standards, and platform roadmaps.
Partner with Product and Data leadership to plan, sequence, and execute multi-quarter initiatives.
Define robust platform abstractions, APIs, and SLAs to streamline developer workflows and increase adoption.
Ensure infrastructure resilience through comprehensive monitoring, incident management, disaster recovery, and cost optimization.
Work cross-functionally with Security, Audit, and Analytics Engineering to deploy key capabilities and compliance controls.

Cross-Functional Partnership

Engage with Data, Product, and Finance partners to enable machine learning, experimentation, and business reporting.
Establish and enforce organization-wide standards for pipeline reliability, data security, and quality.

Technical Leadership

Advocate for automation, engineering best practices, and thoughtful trade-offs between execution speed and long-term scalability.
Thrive in fast-paced, ambiguous settings while cultivating senior technical leaders and building leadership succession through delegated autonomy, developing senior technical leaders and succession depth.

Requirements:

Required Qualifications

10+ years of experience in software engineering, SRE or infrastructure, data platform engineering, or related fields.
4+ years managing high-performing technical teams, growing and developing people
Deep expertise with Snowflake/Google BigQuery/Databricks or equivalent modern data warehousing systems and ecosystem of tools including Airflow, DBT etc.
Familiarity with Git and CI/CD workflows
Strong understanding of data warehousing concepts and infrastructure workload management.
Experience defining data security, platform SLAs and governance frameworks.
Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills.
Demonstrated ability to influence technical strategy across multiple organizations.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience delivering customer-facing data products is a plus
Experience scaling platform organizations through rapid company growth.
Familiarity with event-driven data architectures, data science & product analytics computational needs and patterns is a plus.
Experience supporting experimentation platforms and machine learning initiatives.
Knowledge of metrics governance and executive KPI frameworks.

Success in your First Year:

Within your first 12 months, you will:

Build strong relationships with leaders across Product, Engineering, Finance, and Go-to-Market.
Improve trust in data through stronger governance and controls.
Increase data consumptions and data-powered products across the organization.
Establish scalable development standards and improve engineering velocity.
Grow and mentor a high-performing data platform engineering team.
Deliver a roadmap that supports both current business needs and future scale.

jobs.title: Assistant Vice President, Infrastructure
jobs.description:
The University at Buffalo
(UB) invites nominations and applications for the position of Assistant Vice President of Infrastructure (AVP). Reporting to the Vice President and Chief Information Officer, the AVP will be responsible for leading the Enterprise Infrastructure Services and Network and Communication Services units across UB's three campuses.

University at Buffalo

Impactful research
,scholarly distinction, transformative student experiences, and far-reaching service to local, state, national, and international communities define UB's mission as one of the nation's leading public research universities. UB was founded in 1846 as a private medical college located in downtown Buffalo and joined the SUNY network in 1962. SUNY is the largest state university system in the United States, and UB is a flagship campus and the largest and most comprehensive public research university within the system. In 1989, UB was among the first public universities in the Northeast to be admitted into the AAU. Over the years, UB's scope and mission have expanded significantly as it has grown into a world-renowned research university that is the thriving heart of the regional community, a national leader in public higher education, and a global hub for excellence in research and education.

UB enrolls more than 32,000 students (approximately two-thirds undergraduate and one-third graduate and professional students) and offers more than 500 degree programs at the baccalaureate, master's, professional, and doctoral levels acrossits 12 decanal units
. UB has a distinguished faculty of over 1,500 full-time members. UB is currently undertaking its largest faculty­ hiring initiative in recent history, Advancing Top 25: UB Faculty Hiring
, with plans to recruit upward of 200 full-time faculty over the next two years.

UB is home to more than 120 research centers and institutes; its current annual research expenditures, including those in affiliated institutions, exceed $425 million. UB's academic programs and facilities are located on three distinct campuses in the Buffalo metropolitan area. UB's North Campus, located in the suburb of Amherst, is the university's main undergraduate campus and home to the university's primary athletics and cultural facilities. Three miles to the south, on the northern edge of the City of Buffalo, is the university's historic South Campus, home to many of the university's professional schools. The focal point of UB's third, downtown campus center is the Buffalo Niagara Medical Campus, on which UB's state-of-the-art Jacobs School of Medicine and Biomedical Sciences is in proximity to the university's health and life science partners. UB also competes in the prestigious Mid-American Conference and at the highest level of National Collegiate Athletic Association (NCAA) competition, the FBS Division I level.

With an annual operating revenue of $850 million, UB and its affiliated entities generate an estimated economic impact of $2.1 billion annually in New York State. The university's total workforce of over 9,000 full-time equivalent employees makes it one of the region's largest employers. UB is also a leader and an active partner with the more than 20 public and private colleges and universities in the Buffalo-Niagara region.

The Position

The Assistant Vice President for Infrastructure (AVP)
is a dynamic and visionary leader that is a strategic partner and advisor to the Vice President and Chief Information Officer (VPCIO)
. This is a VPCIO Cabinet Leadership
position that plays a pivotal role in shaping and growing the UB Information Technology (UBIT)
organization to align with and advance the university's goals. As a member of the VPCIO Cabinet, the AVP will ensure that UBIT’s people, processes, and technology are equipped to support the university's mission. The AVP directs special projects and strategic priorities as assigned by the VPCIO, spanning institutional planning, cross-divisional partnerships, and IT governance. This position serves as a senior thought leader in the university’s digital transformation efforts, proactively contributing towards the future direction of technology at the university.

The AVP for Infrastructure
provides strategic leadership for the Enterprise Infrastructure Services (EIS
) and Network and Communication Services (NCS)
units, ensuring UB’s network, cloud, data center, and core computer environments remain secure, reliable, and scalable, while advancing technologies, systems, and processes to meet UB’s goals. Working closely with campus partners and IT leadership, the AVP drives coordinated service delivery, continuous improvement, and infrastructure innovation that supports the university’s academic, research, and administrative needs.

This is a newly created role, and the AVP
will have the opportunity to shape how these two units – each with its own history, culture, and operating rhythm – come together as a single, unified infrastructure organization. The successful candidate will build trust across both teams while also thinking beyond day-to-day operations: reassessing UB’s data center footprint, advancing a deliberate cloud and colocation strategy, and positioning the university’s infrastructure to support an ambitious research and AI agenda. The AVP
will need to balance the discipline required to keep mission-critical systems running with the vision to challenge long-standing practices and move UBIT’s infrastructure into closer alignment with where the university is headed.

Key Responsibilities

Departmental Leadership

Provide strategic direction and oversight to the EIS and NCS units, which includes establishing and advancing a cohesive portfolio strategy aligned with the university’s mission and goals and VPCIO priorities, ensuring coordination across infrastructure and communication systems, emerging technologies, and customer-facing services
This role carries a substantive policymaking function. By directing the planning, design, and operation of the university’s data networks, telecommunications, and enterprise infrastructure systems, the AVP leads the establishment and enforcement of the technical and operational policies that guide campus wide technology use, reliability, security, and compliance. The position’s regular engagement with senior academic and administrative leadership ensures that infrastructure standards and related policies align with institutional priorities.
Lead long-range and annual planning, including workforce and succession planning, budget oversight, and investment prioritization to ensure sustainable operations and future-ready capabilities
Assess the current structure, staffing levels, and operations of EIS and NCS, and lead the organizational changes needed to address staffing gaps, evolving service demands, and succession needs, given the significant portion of both units’ workforce eligible for retirement in the coming years
Foster a culture of innovation, accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement by promoting professional development, mentoring leaders, and enabling teams to deliver high-quality, secure, and customer-centered IT solutions

Drive Strategic Alignment

Ensure that IT initiatives are closely aligned with the university’s strategic goals and mission
Work with university leadership to shape, prioritize, and execute projects that support academic, administrative, and research objectives, while balancing divisional advocacy with institutional priorities and shared enterprise outcomes

Foster Synergies

Promote collaboration and synergy among UBIT departments including but not limited to Innovation, Enterprise Application Services, IT Customer Experience, and Research IT
Leverage strengths and expertise to create a cohesive, efficient IT environment that enhances performance and innovation

Innovate and Transform

Champion innovation and transformation and identify opportunities for technological advancements, process improvements, and new initiatives that move the university forward

At SentiLink, you'll work alongside smart, highly collaborative colleagues who respect each other's time and judgment, take ownership, and follow through on their commitments. Together, we do truly meaningful work protecting the identities of innocent consumers and flagging the fraudsters attempting to exploit them.

We're well capitalized and growing quickly. Role

We’re looking for a strong Senior Engineering Manager to lead a backend/platform-focused engineering team responsible for powering SentiLink’s core products.

We are looking for a manager who is fundamentally a strong backend engineer and enjoys staying close to technical work, contributing to architecture, guiding design decisions, and unblocking complex systems challenges.

Requirements

Description & Requirements

Technology Director | Global Sourcing Technology

Who we are

lululemon is an innovative performance apparel company for yoga, running, training, and other athletic pursuits. Setting the bar in technical fabrics and functional design, we create transformational products and experiences that support people in moving, growing, connecting, and being well. We owe our success to our innovative product, emphasis on stores, commitment to our people, and the incredible connections we make in every community we're in. As a company, we focus on creating positive change to build a healthier, thriving future. In particular, that includes creating an equitable, inclusive and growth-focused environment for our people.

About This Team

Global Supply Chain Technology delivers the platforms and capabilities that power lululemon’s supply chain—from raw material innovation and development, costing, sourcing, quality, sustainability and traceability, trade, logistics, and distribution technology. Our team works in close partnership with core business units to ensure that our supply chain remains agile, efficient, and responsive to ever-evolving market demands. By continuously innovating and refining our technological solutions, we enable best-in-class supply chain operations to service our Guests and our stores. This collaborative approach ensures we provide exceptional experiences and support lululemon’s growth in every community we serve.

The role

We are seeking a Technology Director to define and execute the multi year strategy for modernizing and transforming lululemon’s global sourcing technology ecosystem. This leader will shape the strategic roadmap, elevate costing and sourcing platform capabilities, advance AI driven decisioning, and ensure operational excellence across the systems that connect lululemon to its global vendor base.

You will own all aspects of technology for Global Sourcing—architecture, engineering, security, QA automation, operations, and delivery—and oversee a globally distributed team across North America and India. You will be accountable for the platforms that support approximately 300 raw material (RM) and finished goods (FG) vendors globally, and will partner with Enterprise Architecture and Engineering on the technology evolution required to support enterprise initiatives. This role requires a seasoned leader with a proven record of developing a strong leadership bench, managing complex solutions, and thriving in complex, fast paced, and highly collaborative environments.

Partner connectivity (vendors, mills, agents, service providers)
Integration frameworks (EDI, APIs, event-driven architecture)
Master data and data quality for cost
Sourcing analytics, margin visibility, exception management, and operational dashboards

Strategic Leadership & Roadmap

Translate business needs into an actionable engineering roadmap incorporating modernization, cloud migration, supplier collaboration, and responsible AI adoption.
Partner with business Directors, Sr. Directors, and VPs across Global Sourcing and Costing to define, deliver, and support the strategic roadmap.
Enroll cross functional technology partners in the strategic vision for Global Sourcing, and lead the creation and expansion of new capabilities that align with our strategic goals.

Platform & Architecture Modernization

Modernize existing costing and sourcing platforms and integrate next generation capabilities (costing engines, sourcing execution suites, or equivalent).
Drive transformation toward API-first, event-driven, and scalable integration architectures across the global vendor base.
Lead design and implementation of secure, resilient, and responsible data management and governance frameworks for material, vendor, and cost master data.
Partner with Enterprise Architecture and Engineering on technology evolution that supports enterprise initiatives.

Engineering Leadership

Lead globally distributed engineering, QA automation, delivery, and support teams; develop managers and future-ready technical leaders.
Serve as the escalation point for Technology Managers to support delivery, making thoughtful decisions on the fly and constantly clearing roadblocks.
Raise engineering standards around quality, observability, security, and system reliability.
Build high performing, diverse teams with a culture of inclusion, transparency, and continuous improvement, and support career progression and stretch opportunities across the Global Sourcing technology area.

Operational Excellence

Oversee delivery, operations, and vendor/partner management across sourcing and costing systems, and own the relationship with key vendor partners.
Manage budgets for strategic initiatives and baseline opex for Global Sourcing technology, ensuring clear ROI and optimization of total cost of ownership.
Drive root cause analysis, systems reliability, service maturity, and measurable operational improvements.

Innovation & AI Enablement

Introduce AI-driven decision support for should-cost modelling, quote analysis, capacity allocation, vendor performance, and exception management.
Champion ethical, transparent, and responsible use of AI in sourcing and vendor-facing operations.

Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, related field, or commensurate relative experience.
15+ years of experience in technology, including 4+ years in a senior leadership position such as a Technology Manager or Technology Director.
Experience leading large scale initiatives and modernization efforts for supply chain platforms, with highly valued experience in costing and sourcing areas.
Proven success delivering transformations in areas such as product costing, sourcing execution, purchase order management, supplier collaboration, or vendor connectivity.
Strong background in integration architectures (API platforms, EDI, message streaming, event-driven design).
Hands-on experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP).
Proficiency in programming languages such as Python or Java and familiarity with data engineering patterns.
Demonstrated ability to manage large budgets and deliver high-impact technology programs.
Exceptional communication, storytelling, and executive influencing skills.
Continuous learning mindset that stays on the leading edge of sourcing and supply chain technology solutions that can bring value to the organization.
Experience with AI/ML use cases in supply chain, sourcing, or costing.
Understanding of apparel or consumer goods product development, raw materials, and global vendor management processes.
Experience working with distributed teams across multiple time zones and a global vendor base.

Success Metrics

Improved cost accuracy, margin visibility, and speed of costing cycles.
Reduced sourcing and purchase order cycle times, with fewer manual touches per order.
Improved reliability, uptime, and SLA performance of sourcing and costing systems.
Strong engagement scores and leadership development of global teams.

Must Haves

Acknowledges the presence of choice in every moment and takes personal responsibility for their life.
Possesses an entrepreneurial spirit and continuously innovates to achieve great results.
Communicates with honesty and kindness and creates the space for others to do the same.
Leads with courage, knowing the possibility of greatness is bigger than the fear of failure.
Fosters connection by putting people first and building trusting relationships.
Integrates fun and joy as a way of being and working, aka doesn’t take themselves too seriously.

Supported by operating principles of being strategy-led, values-based and disciplined in execution, you’ll be inspired, connected, developed and rewarded here. Everything that makes you unique is welcome; join us and let’s build what’s next - together!
Anaplan is looking for an entrepreneurial and highly strategic  VP, Technology Partnerships
. This is a stellar opportunity to lead a high-visibility, global organization within a leading enterprise cloud company. If you are an ecosystem builder who thrives on defining technology alliance strategies, rolling up your sleeves to drive execution, scaling a developer and partner apps ecosystem, and building a high-performing global team from the ground up, this role is for you.

Your focus will be centered on developing strategic Technology, Data/AI, and Cloud partnerships, alongside leading and expanding the Partner Apps program to drive platform extensibility and customer value. In parallel, you will curate high-leverage "Power of Three" motions—aligning Anaplan, technology partners, and System Integrators (SIs) to deliver comprehensive, differentiated enterprise solutions. Tip of the Spear Execution:

Partner Apps Program Leadership:
Lead the end-to-end strategy, governance, technical enablement, and commercial execution of Anaplan’s Partner Apps program to accelerate platform extensibility, marketplace growth, and new recurring revenue streams.

GTM Translation & Cross-Functional Alignment GTM Integration & Scalability:

"Power of 3" Orchestration:

Accountability & Execution:
Move seamlessly between high-level strategic alliance design and hands-on operational execution. Foster a high-performance culture that manages partner milestones strictly to plan and continuously measures partner-sourced and partner-influenced impact.
Ecosystem Evangelism:
Serve as a prominent executive sponsor and thought leader for Anaplan’s technology alliances and Partner Apps ecosystem, representing Anaplan at industry conferences, partner summits, and executive advisory boards.

You are energized by ambiguity, possess an entrepreneurial mindset, and have a proven track record of establishing high-impact technology partnerships and commercializing platform application ecosystems.

Deep, verifiable experience identifying, structuring, and expanding strategic partnerships with ISVs, Data Cloud/AI platforms (e.g., Snowflake, Databricks), and major Cloud Service Providers (AWS, Azure, GCP).
Partner Apps & Platform Extensibility:

Incubation to Revenue:

Executive Presence & Influence:

Technical Acumen:
Strong understanding of enterprise SaaS architectures, APIs, data pipelines, and cloud platform topologies to credibly lead joint solution development with product and engineering counterparts.
Team Building & People Leadership:
Extensive experience building, leading, and mentoring high-performing global alliance teams, with clear accountability for execution and pipeline results.

Preferred Experience SI & "Power of Three" Collaboration:
Strong familiarity with Global System Integrators (GSIs) and proven experience curating tripartite ("Power of 3") motions combining technology partners, SIs, and software platforms to win large enterprise transformations.
Hyper-Growth SaaS Track Record:
10+ years of progressive leadership in technology alliances, strategic business development, or partner ecosystems within high-growth enterprise software companies.

Partner-Driven & Influenced ACV:
Net-new annual contract value (ACV) sourced and influenced through technology partnerships and tripartite "Power of 3" plays.

Growth in active partner apps, developer adoption, customer installations, and attributable revenue generated via the Partner Apps program.
Strategic Alliances Formalized:

Number of certified, customer-facing technical integrations and joint solution briefs successfully launched to the market.
