At Omnissa, we are committed to maintaining a fair, consistent, and secure hiring process for all candidates. As part of this approach, we use standard interview and verification practices designed to ensure alignment and protect both candidates and the organization. These practices are applied thoughtfully and with respect for candidate privacy.

What is the opportunity?

We are looking for an experienced Engineering Manager to lead our Frontline Engineering team within UEM Engineering. This team serves as a critical bridge between customers, Support, and Product Engineering. The team takes ownership of complex and high-impact customer escalations that require deep technical investigation, helping identify root causes, drive issues toward resolution, and ensure that learnings from escalations translate into improvements in product quality and engineering practices. As the Engineering Manager, you will build and lead a team of strong technical engineers who can independently investigate complex issues across the Workspace ONE UEM platform. You will partner closely with Product Engineering, Technical Support, Product Management, TPMs, and Quality Engineering to improve escalation handling and reduce recurring customer issues. You will also help evolve the Frontline Engineering function by leveraging AI, automation, and improved diagnostics to accelerate investigations, reduce manual effort, identify recurring patterns, and turn customer escalations into actionable engineering insights. This is an engineering leadership role with a strong focus on technical depth, customer impact, operational excellence, AI-driven innovation, and continuous product improvement.

What You’ll Do

Build, lead, mentor, and develop a high-performing team of Frontline Engineers.
Own engineering engagement and execution for complex, high-priority customer escalations.
Act as the frontline layer for Product Engineering, absorbing and resolving escalations so development teams experience less unplanned, interrupt-driven work and can focus on planned roadmap execution.
Establish clear processes for escalation intake, prioritization, investigation, ownership, and resolution.
Partner closely with Product Engineering teams to troubleshoot complex issues and identify defects, regressions, configuration issues, and product gaps.
Drive strong RCA practices, including clear documentation of root causes, contributing factors, corrective actions, and preventive measures.
Identify patterns and trends across customer escalations and translate those insights into product and quality improvements.
Partner with Quality Engineering and development teams to identify gaps in test coverage and recommend additional automated or regression testing based on real-world customer issues.
Help prioritize fixes and patch candidates based on customer impact, severity, risk, and technical analysis.
Drive the adoption of AI-assisted tools to improve escalation triage, troubleshooting, root-cause analysis, and resolution time.
Identify opportunities to use AI to analyze logs, telemetry, historical escalations, and known issues to accelerate technical investigations.
Leverage AI and automation to identify recurring failure patterns and proactively surface potential product quality issues.
Define and track metrics that measure the effectiveness of the Frontline Engineering function, including escalation volume, resolution time, recurring issues across customers, and reduction in Product Engineering time spent on escalations.
Develop engineers’ technical depth and their ability to independently troubleshoot complex distributed systems and enterprise environments.
Participate in hiring and growing the Frontline Engineering organization as the function expands.

What will you bring to Omnissa?

Proven experience leading engineers in software engineering, escalation engineering, sustaining engineering, or a similar technical organization.
Strong technical background with experience troubleshooting complex enterprise software and distributed systems.
Experience investigating production or customer-reported issues and driving them through root-cause analysis and resolution.
Strong understanding of software development, testing, debugging, release, and patching processes.
Ability to work across engineering teams and drive resolution when issues span multiple components or ownership boundaries.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify patterns across seemingly unrelated customer issues.
Experience using logs, telemetry, diagnostics, APIs, databases, and other troubleshooting tools to investigate complex technical problems.
Ability to balance customer urgency with engineering priorities and long-term product quality.
Excellent communication and collaboration skills, including the ability to communicate technical issues clearly to engineering leaders and cross-functional stakeholders.
Demonstrated ability to hire, mentor, develop, and grow engineers.
Strong interest in applying AI and automation to improve engineering efficiency, troubleshooting, and customer outcomes.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with enterprise mobility management, endpoint management, device management, SaaS platforms, or large-scale enterprise software.
Experience with Workspace ONE UEM or similar endpoint management platforms is a strong plus.
Experience working with geographically distributed engineering and support organizations.
Experience with automation, observability, diagnostics, and engineering productivity tools.
Experience using customer escalation data to influence engineering priorities, test strategy, and product quality.

Location:
Atlanta, GA or Mountain View, CA

Location Type:
hybrid

Travel Expectations:
None

Education:
Bachelor's Degree preferred, or equivalent combination of education and relevant professional experience.

Compensation:
The typical base salary for this role is between USD $177,000 - 325,000 per year and it may be eligible for participation in a corporate bonus program. Actual compensation offer may vary from posted hiring range based upon geographic location, work experience, education, skill level, or other relevant factors. In addition to competitive compensation, Omnissa offers a variety of benefits such as employee ownership, health insurance, 401k with matching contributions, disability insurance, paid-time off, growth opportunities, and more.

All employment decisions at Omnissa are based on business needs, job requirements and individual qualifications, without regard to race, color, religion, ancestry, ethnicity, national, social or ethnic origin, sex (including pregnancy), age, physical, mental or sensory disability, HIV status, sexual orientation, gender identity and/or expression, marital, civil union or domestic partnership status, past, present, or prospective service in the uniformed services, family medical history or genetic information, family or parental status, veteran status, or any other status protected by applicable laws or regulations in the locations where we operate. Omnissa will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics. Omnissa welcomes applicants of all ages. new_jobs.title: Senior Manager, Data Engineering
new_jobs.description:
Strength in Trust

OneTrust’s mission is to enable innovation through the responsible use of data and AI. We believe that ensuring data is trusted shouldn’t slow teams down—it should accelerate what’s possible. This led us to develop the first technology platform for responsible data use in 2016. Today, with AI representing the latest and most impactful expansion of data yet, OneTrust is once again redefining what responsible innovation looks like. OneTrust, the AI‑Ready Governance Platform™, unifies regulatory intelligence, automation, and connected governance workflows so businesses can continue to move at the speed of AI while ensuring good governance to prevent data misuse at scale. Trusted by thousands of organizations worldwide, OneTrust is shaping the future where trusted data becomes a transformative force for business and society.

The Challenge

As Senior Manager, Data Engineering and Platform you will be a people leader of a team of Data Engineers responsible for creating platform and data engineering architecture for business intelligence and data science solutions. This role will have a substantial focus on coaching and people management alongside a strong individual contributor component in hands-on data engineering.

Your Mission

You will work closely with other team members like data architects and business analysts to understand what the business is trying to achieve, move data from source to target, and design optimal data models.

Develop and adhere to standard methodologies: platform architecture, data engineering, data quality, analysis, validation to ensure the team provides quality work to company and build trust with analytics solutions.
Propose and socialize data architecture to enable OneTrust business analytics.
Drive technical conversations with stakeholders to explore all facets of problem and solution.
Solve immediate production issues with an eye to solve things for long-term.
Work with vendors and security teams for appropriate data controls.
Partner with cross functional teams to align on product usage data, business data, development standards and overall data strategy.
Design and build facts, dimensions, snapshots, SCDs in Snowflake/Databricks using dbt/airflow/elt tools. Maintain robust, trusted data models.
Hire and retain top data engineering talent.
Assist in the growth of each employee through coaching and career development activities.

You Are

Seeking someone who can leverage a deep technical understanding of data engineering, data warehousing, and data architecture while leading and motivating an on-call team of engineers in a challenging, dynamic environment.

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
10+ years of professional data engineering experience. Acting as an incident commander during critical outages.
Extensive experience with data architecture, tool evaluations, data modeling, and building ETL pipelines.
Experience working in high-growth, fast-paced environment.
Experience working with distributed teams across geos.
Experience evaluating new data engineering tools and enriching existing architecture.
Strong data warehouse knowledge and ability to write complex SQL for processing raw data, data validation, and QA.
Experience with Python and manipulation of various data formats for extraction and transformation.

Extra Awesome

Experience using AI in a data engineering context
Experience managing distributed teams across geos.
Experience in designing Data Warehouse: ACV, ARR, Event History, Identity Resolution, Deferred Revenue, Revenue Metrics, Experimentation, Audience
Growth Learner: Desire to continue to learn about the future architecture of data technologies.

For California, Colorado, Connecticut, Nevada, New York, Rhode Island, and Washington-based candidates: the annual base pay range for this role is listed below. Within this range, individual pay is determined by several factors, including location, job-related skills, work experience, and relevant education and/or training. This role may also be eligible for discretionary bonuses, equity, and/or commissions, as well as benefits.

Salary Range

$153,750—$230,625 USD

Where we Work

We are embracing an office-first culture, encouraging three days a week in office for most roles, with meaningful opportunities to collaborate and celebrate in person.

Each role may have specific requirements or flexibility depending on the scope of the position, so we encourage you to verify this with your recruiter during your first interview.

Benefits

As an employee at OneTrust, you will be part of the OneTeam. That means you’ll receive support physically, mentally, and emotionally so that you can do your best work both in and out of the office. This includes comprehensive healthcare coverage, flexible PTO, equity RSUs, annual performance bonus opportunities, retirement account support, 14+ weeks of paid parental leave, career development opportunities, company-paid privacy certification exam fees, and much more. Specific benefits differ by country. For more information, talk to your recruiter or visit onetrust.com/careers.

Resources

Check out the following to learn more about OneTrust and its people:

OneTrust Careers on YouTube
@LifeatOneTrust on Instagram

Your Data

You have the right to have your personal data updated or removed. You also have the right to have a copy of the information OneTrust holds about you. Further details about these rights are available on the website in our Privacy Overview .
You can change your mind at any time and have your personal data removed from our database. In order to do this you must contact us and let us know you wish to be removed. The request should be made on the Data Subject Request Form.

Recruitment fraud warning: OneTrust is aware of scams involving false offers of employment with our company. The fraudulent jobs, interviews and job offers use fake websites, email addresses, group chat and text messages. Be aware that we never ask candidates for personal information, IDs or bank information during the interview process. We do not interview prospective candidates via instant message or group chat, and do not require candidates to purchase products or services, or process payments on our behalf as a condition of any employment offer. Please note that any legitimate interview availability requests will come directly from a OneTrust recruiter with an "@onetrust.com" email address. You may also receive legitimate emails from "@us.greenhouse-mail.io". Recruiters will only reach out to candidates who have applied for a role through our ATS (Greenhouse) or prospects via LinkedIn InMail. Job offers will come from a recruiter and may have a "@docusign.net" email address. For more information or if you have been targeted please reach out to askrecruiting@onetrust.com.

Our Commitment to You

When you join OneTrust you are stepping onto a launching pad — the countdown has begun. The destination? A career without boundaries working alongside a diverse and inclusive crew who is passionate about doing meaningful work. As a pioneer, your voice and expertise will help chart the direction of an entirely new category. Our commitment to putting people first starts with you. Your growth is part of the mission. Our goal is to give you the power to embark on the next phase of your uniquely, unique career.

OneTrust provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by local laws.

new_jobs.title: Senior Engineering Manager, Video Enablement
new_jobs.description:
About GameChanger

We believe in the life-changing impact youth sports have on and off the field because they encourage leadership, teamwork, responsibility, and confidence—important life lessons that have the power to propel our youth toward meaningful futures. We recognize that without coaches, parents, and volunteers, organized youth sports could not exist. By building the first and best place to experience the youth sports moments important to our community, we are helping families elevate the next generation through youth sports.

So if you love sports and their community-building potential, or building cool products is your sport, GameChanger is the team for you. We are a remote-first, dynamic tech company based in New York City, and we are solving some of the biggest challenges in youth sports today.

The Position

At GameChanger we score and stream millions of youth sports games annually. We are seeking a talented Senior Engineering Manager who is passionate about live-streaming to manage our video enablement team. This full-stack, empowered team is dedicated to all things core video experience - owning our video pipeline end to end with our video platform team, evolving our live streaming and post-game video capabilities for users, simplifying the developer experience for product teams that are integrating video into our apps, and ensuring we have a scalable and resilient base in our apps/APIs to handle millions of streams and hundreds of millions of highlight clips annually.

As Senior Engineering Manager, you’ll manage our enablement team and set them up for success by continuing to monitor/adjust the team’s culture, collaborate on the vision of video enablement within our products, influencing design/architecture principles and best practices, growing tomorrow’s leaders, and running the day to day of the team. As an excellent communicator and builder of people, you will be a leader, a mentor, and occasional hands-on developer or solutions architect and work closely with the video teams Engineering Director, engineers, product managers, and other cross-functional roles and teams.

Check out some of our current video capabilities at https://gc.com/app-features/live-streaming

What You’ll Do

Partner closely with the Director of Video Engineering, a dedicated PM, and cross-functional feature teams to help shape and execute on GC's video streaming roadmap - contributing your technical perspective while working within a collaborative, already-thriving team dynamic.
Lead the Video Enablement team through the design, build, and support of core video capabilities, including third-party device integration support (ex: GoPro, Mevo, etc.), mobile-first live streaming and capture, ingest, transcode, storage, and playback.
Continuously measure and improve live and VOD streaming experiences, bringing data and user empathy to every decision.
Hire, onboard, and grow a high-performing team of mobile, backend, and infrastructure engineers - preserving and extending a culture of ownership, curiosity, and craft while mentoring engineers into tomorrow's technical leaders.
Serve as a hands-on technical leader: staying sharp enough to review code, contribute when needed, and credibly mentor a team of senior and staff engineers while working alongside leadership peers to build on what's working rather than reinventing it.
Partner with infrastructure teams to maintain a resilient, scalable, and cost-efficient video pipeline in AWS.
Enable product feature teams and computer vision teams to build on top of video infrastructure through clear interfaces, documentation, and collaboration.
Stay engaged during production incidents and pitch in when the team needs support.

What You’ll Bring

Strong background in video and audio streaming, with hands-on experience in user-generated content and live streaming technologies, and a proven track record of delivering projects in that space.
A leadership style rooted in collaboration, someone who earns trust by listening first, understands the existing landscape before suggesting changes, and influences through ideas rather than authority.
Solid understanding of software engineering principles and cloud architecture in a resilient, scalable video infrastructure environment (we use AWS).
Ability to think strategically and contribute to the long-term vision of the engineering team along with your leadership partners in the space.
Comfort operating as a player-coach: you're not writing code every day, but you're close enough to the work to be credible, helpful, and a genuine resource to your team.
Experience coding in languages common in the video space (Go, Rust, C#) is a plus, as is familiarity with Node/TypeScript, React, or mobile languages like Kotlin or Swift.

Who You Are

A proven engineering leader with a track record of delivering in the video streaming space, doing it with your team, not just through them.
Energized by high visibility and high stakes. Our platform handles millions of live streams and hundreds of millions of clips annually, and a lot of people across the org depend on what we build.
Someone who sees a strong existing team and culture as an asset to build on, not a blank slate to redesign.
An excellent communicator who can bridge technical depth and stakeholder clarity without losing either.
Genuinely user-obsessed - you care about the experience on the other end of the stream.
Curious and current: you follow the evolution of video technology and bring relevant ideas to the table without chasing trends for their own sake.
Someone who creates an environment where engineers feel safe saying "I don't know" and where postmortems are about learning, not blame.
Comfortable with a remote-first, async-by-default culture - you communicate proactively in writing, don't need a meeting to make progress, and trust others to do the same.

How We Work

We are a fully remote team of 5-9 engineers building and running video infrastructure, APIs, and SDKs that other teams utilize and depend on. We take that seriously.

We run two-week sprints with async daily standups in Slack, weekly refinement, and three syncs a week (two during planning weeks). We have a strong bias toward async-first communication and only pull people into meetings when it actually makes sense. When we do meet, it counts.

Our platform runs 24x7, and when something goes wrong we're all in it together, leaders included. We don't have a formal on-call rotation for managers, but we expect our leaders to be engaged and present when production issues arise, and to pitch in when the team needs them.

When things don't go as planned, we run blameless postmortems focused on learning and improving, not pointing fingers. Nobody on this team is afraid to say "I don't know", that's a feature, not a bug.

We also know that great teams are built on more than just good work. Every two weeks we connect for a remote game night. It's a small thing that means a lot to us.

If you're looking for a high-impact team that's genuinely invested in each other, the product, and doing things the right way, we'd love to talk.

Perks

Work remotely throughout the US* or from our well-furnished, modern office in Manhattan, NY.
Unlimited vacation policy.
Paid volunteer opportunities.
Technology stipend - $4,000 every 2 years after your start to make sure you have the latest and greatest technology.
WFH stipend - $500 annually to make your WFH situation comfortable.
Learning stipend - $500 annually towards continued development.
Monthly physical, mental, wellness & learning stipend offered through Holisticly.
Monthly lifestyle stipend offered through Fringe.
Full health benefits - medical, dental, vision, prescription, FSA, HRA, HSA, and coverage for family/dependents.
Retirement savings - Traditional and Roth 401K plans are offered through Vanguard, with an immediate company match.
Life insurance - basic life, supplemental life, and dependent life.
Disability leave - short-term disability and long-term disability.
Company paid parental leave - up to 20 weeks for birthing parents and up to 12 weeks for non-birthing parents.
Family building benefits offered through Progyny.
DICK'S Sporting Goods and their family of brands teammate discount.

The target salary range for this position is between $209,000 and $235,000. This is part of a competitive total rewards package that includes incentive, equity, and benefits for eligible roles. Individual pay may vary from the target range and is determined by a number of factors including experience, location, internal pay equity, and other relevant business considerations. We review all teammate pay regularly to ensure competitive and fair pay.

DICK’S Sporting Goods has company-wide practices to monitor and protect the company from significant compliance and monetary implications as it pertains to employer state tax liabilities. Due to said guidelines put in place, we are unable to hire in AK, DE, HI, IA, LA, MS, MT, OK, and SC.

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity in our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

Our Interview Process & AI

We recognize that AI has become a common part of everyday life and professional work, and its use continues to evolve rapidly. Our perspective on AI in the hiring process will evolve as well. At this time, we ask that candidates please refrain from using AI tools during interviews and assessments, as we want to see your authentic self. We will clearly indicate if and when AI use is acceptable in the process. If you have any questions or need accommodations, we're here to help. Thanks for helping us keep the process fair and secure for everyone!

IMPORTANT NOTICE:
All official recruitment communications from GameChanger will come from an email address ending in @gc.com or no-reply@ashby.hq.com. If you receive communication from any other domain, please be cautious, as it is likely fraudulent.

new_jobs.title: Senior Manager, Data Platform Engineering
new_jobs.description:
At SolarWinds, we’re a people-first company. Our purpose is to enrich the lives of the people we serve—including our employees, customers, shareholders, partners, and communities. Join us in our mission to help customers accelerate business transformation with simple, powerful, and secure solutions.
The ideal candidate thrives in an innovative, fast-paced environment and is collaborative, accountable, ready, and empathetic. We’re looking for individuals who believe they can accomplish more as a team and create lasting growth for themselves and others. We hire based on attitude, competency, and commitment. Solarians are ready to advance our world-class solutions in a fast-paced environment and accept the challenge to lead with purpose. If you’re looking to build your career with an exceptional team, you’ve come to the right place. Join SolarWinds and grow with us!
ROLE OVERVIEW

SolarWinds is hiring a Senior Manager, Data Platform Engineering to build and lead the team responsible for administering and configuring the Enterprise Data tech stack — Fivetran, BigQuery, Dataplex, dbt, and Tableau. This person will set technical direction and architecture standards across the platform, and build, coach, and grow the team that executes day to day.
This is a working-manager (player-coach) role, not a pure people-management position: the team is small today, and this person is expected to stay technically close to the platform — setting patterns and making architecture calls, and personally covering tech-stack administration the team hasn't yet grown to cover — while delegating hands-on execution to their report(s) where it exists.
You'll balance hands-on technical leadership with people management — coaching your team, setting goals, and representing the platform in cross-functional planning with adjacent teams.
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Team leadership & people management

Lead, coach, and grow the Data Platform Engineering team — starting with one direct report, with a plan to scale as workload and budget allow.
Run regular 1:1s, set clear goals, and manage performance and career development for direct report(s).
Own hiring for the team as it grows, partnering with People and the hiring committee on leveling and comp.

Platform architecture & technical direction

Own architecture standards and technical roadmap across the Enterprise Data tech stack — Fivetran, BigQuery, Dataplex, dbt, and Tableau.
Make build-vs-buy and platform-pattern decisions that shape how the team executes day to day.
Stay hands-on enough to unblock the team on hard technical problems, without personally owning routine operational work.

Data tech stack administration & configuration

Ensure Fivetran, BigQuery, Dataplex, dbt, and Tableau are properly administered and configured — access, environments, and platform settings across the stack.
Own dbt Cloud platform administration (environments, scheduling, CI/CD, access); model development and transformation logic remain with Data Engineering.
Own Tableau platform administration (user access, groups, permissions, licensing), scaling this to a dedicated hire as the team grows.
Set and maintain configuration standards so the stack stays consistent, secure, and auditable as the team scales.

Execution oversight

Ensure the team's reliability, cost, and governance commitments — across ingestion, BigQuery, Dataplex/PII access, dbt, and Tableau — are being met.
Review and prioritise the team's operational backlog against the platform roadmap.

Cross-functional partnership

Represent the Data Platform Engineering pillar in planning with Data Engineering, Data Governance, Cloud Security, and Business Intelligence.
Negotiate priorities and dependencies with adjacent teams on the team's behalf, rather than leaving individual engineers to manage those relationships alone.

REQUIRED EXPERIENCE

Technical depth

Deep, hands-on background in Google Cloud Platform, BigQuery, and Dataplex — enough to retain technical credibility and keep setting standards for the team.
Hands-on experience administering and configuring dbt (or a comparable transformation platform) and Fivetran (or a comparable ELT tool).
Experience administering Tableau or a comparable BI platform — permissions, licensing, and platform configuration.
Track record of technical leadership — driving standards, mentoring engineers, or leading initiatives — even without formal management experience.

Leadership experience

Experience or demonstrated readiness to lead a technical team — formal people-management experience is helpful but not required.
Demonstrated ability to balance architecture/strategic work with hands-on operational realities.
Strong communication skills — able to represent the team's priorities and trade-offs to peers and senior leadership.

PREFERRED EXPERIENCE

Prior experience leading or mentoring a technical team, even informally (tech lead, staff-level mentorship, project leadership).
Experience scaling a team from one or two people to a larger group.

SolarWinds will consider all qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, disability, veteran status or any other characteristic protected by law.
All applications are treated in accordance with the SolarWinds Privacy Notice: https://www.solarwinds.com/applicant-privacy-notice

new_jobs.title: Head of Life and Annuities Technology
new_jobs.description:
Job Family

IT Operations

About Us

At Transamerica, hard work, innovative thinking, and personal accountability are qualities we honor and reward. We understand the potential of leveraging the talents of a diverse workforce. We embrace an environment where employees enjoy a balance between their careers, families, communities, and personal interests.

Ultimately, we appreciate the uniqueness of a company where talented professionals work collaboratively in a positive environment — one focused on helping people look forward and plan for the best life possible while providing tools and solutions that make it easier to get there.

Who We Are

We believe everyone deserves to live their best life. More than a century ago, we were among the first financial services companies in America to serve everyday people from all walks of life.

Today, we’re part of an international holding company, with millions of customers and thousands of employees worldwide. Our insurance, retirement, and investment solutions help people make the most of what’s important to them.

We’re empowered by a vast agent network covering North America, with diversity to match. Together with our nonprofit research institute and foundation, we tune in, step up, and are a force for good — for our customers and the communities where we live, work, and play. United in our purpose, we help people create the financial freedom to live life on their terms.

What We Do

Transamerica is organized into three distinct businesses. These include 1) World Financial Group, including Transamerica Financial Advisors, 2) Protection Solutions and Savings & Investments, comprised of life insurance, annuities, employee benefits, retirement plans, and Transamerica Investment Solutions, and 3) Financial Assets, which includes legacy blocks of long term care, universal life, and variable and fixed annuities. These are supported by Transamerica Corporate, which includes Finance, People and Places, General Counsel, Risk, Internal Audit, Strategy and Development, and Corporate Affairs, which covers Communications, Brand, and Government and Policy Affairs.

Transamerica employs nearly 7,000 people. It’s part of Aegon, an integrated, diversified, international financial services group serving approximately 23.9 million customers worldwide.* For more information, visit transamerica.com. 

Job Description Summary

Enterprise Technology (formerly Global Technology Services) is a global organization within Transamerica. We provide dedicated support to Transamerica, and we bring all Aegon's business units together with technology. We provide the backbone - the infrastructure - for how everything works. We’re creating the company’s AI environment, building a flexible ‘cloud experience’ for internal hosting services, designing frameworks for data governance and management, and ensuring the security and stability of the company’s technology. In short, we enable the business units to move more quickly and deliver to our clients in the best possible way. Whether customers are interested in insurance products or annuities or financial services, we're here to ensure they don't have to worry whether their information is safe.

The people we employ are incredibly diverse, both in terms of backgrounds and skill sets.  There are over 1,000 of us representing a dozen or so nationalities and located in the UK, the US, the Netherlands, and Hungary, Spain, and Hong Kong.  Our global teams are comprised of experts in areas such as application development, information security, infrastructure services, data & analytics, risk & controls, procurement, program management, and architecture.  With the breadth of functions within Enterprise Technology, individuals can pursue a wide variety of careers, and we have a focus on supporting employees’ development.  In particular, our Talent Marketplace enables colleagues to take on gigs to broaden their experience and try out different responsibilities, which can be extremely rewarding.

The most important quality in the people who join us is curiosity.  A lot of what we do is problem solving, requiring colleagues to take what they know and apply it to new situations. We have many mature processes, but we’re always looking for opportunities to improve, so we want people who are naturally inquisitive and confident enough to challenge the way we do things.  Technology is constantly, rapidly changing – we need you to help us continue to change with it. 

Job Description

The Head of Life and Annuities Technology is a transformation-focused leadership role—the primary mandate is not just running technology, but modernizing the life & annuity tech ecosystem to position the business for future growth.

Responsibilities

Define and lead the technology strategy for Protection Solutions and Financial Assets, driving measurable reductions in cost per policy/participant while aligning to enterprise business objectives.
Partner closely with business leaders across the life and annuities domain to shape future-state capabilities, delivering technology solutions that enhance customer experience, operational efficiency, and scalability.
Lead a large, multi-layered technology organization, setting direction for leaders and teams responsible for modernizing platforms, improving system stability, and advancing cloud, data, and AI initiatives.
Drive ongoing modernization efforts, including cloud transformation, data integration, and AI-enabled capabilities, while optimizing performance and reliability of systems already transitioned to the cloud.
Expand the use of standardized architecture and technology practices across interdependent systems, ensuring scalable, secure, and integrated solutions.
Lead vendor and managed services oversight, while advancing insourcing strategies to transition critical capabilities back in-house and strengthen internal engineering maturity.
Direct evaluation of technology platforms and tools to ensure compatibility, integration, and alignment with evolving business and customer needs.
Oversee demand, capacity, and financial management processes, ensuring effective prioritization, resource allocation, and delivery against strategic goals.
Monitor and drive operational and channel performance metrics, executing strategic programs that improve service delivery, cost efficiency, and business outcomes.
Communicate complex technology strategies and business impacts through clear, data-driven insights to senior leaders, enabling informed decision-making and long-term planning.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in information technology, business, or relevant field
15 years of relevant work experience, preferably on a global scale
Demonstrated success leading large, distributed technology organizations and influencing senior executive stakeholders.
Experience leading large-scale cloud and platform modernization initiatives.
Solid understanding of business principles, organizational design, change management, etc.
Large scale budget experience

Preferred Qualifications

Advanced degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Business Administration, or a related field.

Commercial Technology Vision: Define and execute a cohesive technology strategy across all client-facing and revenue-enabling platforms, including data delivery APIs, customer portals, CRM, and the marketing technology stack.

Lead and Develop Talent: Attract, build, and mentor a high-performing, globally distributed engineering organization. Cultivate a culture of innovation, ownership, and operational excellence focused on delivering business impact.

Experience

15+ years of experience in software engineering, with at least 7+ years in a senior leadership role leading client-facing product engineering team.
Demonstrable track record of building and scaling large-scale, commercial B2B platforms, such as enterprise SaaS products, financial data platforms, or API-as-a-product businesses.

Outstanding client-facing communication skills. You are credible and compelling in front of our most strategic and technically sophisticated customers.
A passion for building inclusive, high-energy teams and a reputation as a dedicated mentor and talent developer.
A strong product mindset with a history of building technology that drives tangible business outcomes.

Zscaler (NASDAQ: ZS) accelerates digital transformation so customers can be more agile, efficient, resilient, and secure. The Zscaler Zero Trust Exchange platform protects thousands of customers from cyberattacks and data loss by securely connecting users, devices, and applications in any location. Distributed across 200+ public data centers globally and thousands of private sites at the edge, the SASE-based Zero Trust Exchange is the world’s largest in-line cloud security platform.

We believe the future of work is Human + AI and are building an AI-native enterprise where human potential is amplified by machine intelligence to solve the world’s hardest security challenges. Driven by deep customer obsession, we are committed to the mission, outcome, and to each other. We bring these commitments to life through three core behaviors: ownership and collaboration, trust through outcomes and impact, and a challenge culture with ongoing feedback. Ready to make an impact at the company pioneering security transformation in the AI era? Join us at Zscaler.

Role

We are looking for a Senior Manager, Enterprise Data Platform to join our team. This is a remote (within the US) role, reporting to the Senior Director, Enterprise Data Platform in the IT Data Strategy department. In this role, you will be a key technical and strategic leader responsible for driving the architecture, strategy, and continuous evolution of our modern enterprise data platform.

You will lead the central data team, balancing its evolution into a highly effective, self-service platform team while actively supporting critical, high-impact, organization-wide data initiatives. A core focus of this role is preparing both the central data team and federated business intelligence units (such as Sales, Marketing, and other internal business functions) to become AI-ready, implementing strategies to embed AI directly into daily data analytics. This is a critical leadership position requiring a passionate innovator who is equally comfortable defining high-level strategy, establishing platform governance, and rolling up their sleeves to tackle complex, hands-on technical challenges.

Role

We are looking for a Senior Manager, Enterprise Data Platform to join our team. Serve as the primary architect for the technical and AI roadmap, pivoting the organization from tactical management to high-velocity, intelligence-driven delivery.

Engineering Excellence (The “Strike Team” Model):
Lead and mentor a consolidated team of elite, vetted experts, prioritizing high talent density over volume to ensure 100% certainty in AI and backend execution.

Cross-Functional Leadership:

Act as the stabilizing force during technical transitions, ensuring seamless knowledge transfer of complex AI systems and zero-downtime execution during lead-level rotation.

Architecting systems and strategy for a globally distributed engineering footprint, ensuring high performance across diverse regions.

AI Vision & Roadmap:
Leading the organization’s pivot toward an AI-first product ecosystem, integrating LLMs and proprietary ML models into core offerings.

Strategic Risk Management:
Balancing aggressive technical innovation with the security and compliance requirements of a scaling global enterprise.

new_jobs.title: Director of Technology
new_jobs.description:
This position is on site in Jessup, MD 5 days a week.

The Director of Technology is the single accountable owner of technology at Alliance Material Handling. This role sets and maintains a multi-year technology roadmap covering software, security, data and the skills required to run it, leads the evaluation and implementation of our next ERP platform, builds the data and integration layer that everything else depends on, and brings artificial intelligence and automation into our operations as a working capability rather than a series of demonstrations. The role also owns the project discipline by which all of it gets delivered.

This is a build role. Alliance runs fourteen systems with limited integration, a core ERP that offers no project accounting, and a $210M Warehouse Solutions business that manages job costing, WIP and milestone billing in Excel. We have improved in most of these areas over the last several years, but almost always through brute force, meaning more people, rather than technology. The first requirement for this role is not deep technical expertise. It is the ability to run complex, cross-functional projects to completion and to map and redesign the processes underneath them. We are looking for a program leader who is technically fluent, not a technologist who also manages projects.

What You’ll Do

Technology Strategy & Roadmap
Own and maintain a multi-year technology roadmap covering software, data, staffing and skills, aligned to where the business is going rather than where it has been
Consolidate technology ownership that today is shared across several executives, and serve as the single point of accountability for technology decisions and outcomes, including networking and security
Bring recommendations to the leadership team with costs, risks, payback and a phased plan, and be accountable for delivering what you recommend
Maintain a prioritized, quantified backlog of technology investments and revisit it as the business changes

ERP Evaluation & Implementation
Run an evidence-based evaluation across candidate platforms, scored against documented business requirements and customer demands
Own the relationship with the current ERP vendor, including support obligations, end-of-life exposure, licensing and renewal pricing
Lead implementation once a platform is selected, including scope, sequencing, budget, data migration, testing, training and cutover
Inherit and build on a completed third-party assessment and an open recommendation rather than starting from a blank page

AI & Automation
Build and maintain a prioritized, quantified AI and automation use-case backlog tied to specific processes and dollars
Take a small number of use cases into production and prove value in hours and dollars rather than demonstrations
Establish guardrails for data security, accuracy and human review before any use case reaches production
Report results honestly, including the use cases that do not work and should be stopped

Data, Integration & Reporting
Retire Excel as the reporting layer for job costing, WIP, milestone billing and other core processes
Establish a single source of truth for operational and financial reporting across both the dealership and Warehouse Solutions businesses
Reduce the share of finance and operations time spent assembling data rather than analyzing it

Vendor & Partner Management
Select, scope and manage software vendors, implementation partners and development partners and own the relationship with our existing 3rd party help desk, network and security vendor and ensure effective support across the organization for a competitive cost
Hold partners to delivery against written acceptance standards and dates, renegotiate scope where needed, and end relationships that are not working
Direct outside advisors rather than being directed by them
Review and negotiate technology agreements, renewals and pricing in partnership with Finance

Customer-Driven Requirements
Own the systems response to customer reporting requirements, including standardized weekly progress reporting, daily reporting when a phase slips, material readiness confirmation by component, and consistent units of measure across the life of a project
Work directly with Warehouse Solutions leadership to translate customer requirements into system and process requirements
Deliver a working answer on the required timeline, including an interim manual answer where the system answer is not yet ready

Team, Knowledge & Key-Person Risk
Lead existing and future IT team, including existing and future roles as needed
Identify critical functions that depend on a single individual and retire those dependencies through documentation, cross-training and system change
Build and maintain documentation standards so that knowledge does not live in one person’s head
Partner with department leaders to build technical fluency across the business

Project Execution Standards
Establish and enforce a simple project standard: a named decision that changes, a measured baseline before we start, one named owner, a date with a gate where the answer can be no, and a named person who runs it once it is live
Apply that standard to every technology initiative in the company, including work led by other departments
Report status, risks and gate decisions to the leadership team on a regular cadence

Risk and Problem Management

Provides high-level colocation-provider evaluation input for continuous improvement, driving organizational strategy, scalable delivery, and business objectives.
Oversees the installation and integration of power, cooling, networking, and structured cabling systems, ensuring adherence to quality standards and managing high-impact installation resolutions required for hyperscale and high-density compute deployments.

CORE RESPONSIBILITIES

Planning and Execution

Oversees and guides multiple teams on managing complex programs, projects, or initiatives across the data center delivery lifecycle, monitoring timelines, deliverables, capacity milestones, and budgets when applicable to ensure strategic objectives are met. Prioritizes and reviews the roadmap of improvement initiatives to ensure alignment with strategic direction and maximize return on investments.

new_jobs.title: Senior Manager, Platform Security
new_jobs.description:
About the Company

Gemini is a global crypto and Web3 platform founded by Cameron and Tyler Winklevoss in 2014, offering a wide range of simple, reliable, and secure crypto products and services to individuals and institutions in over 70 countries. Our mission is to unlock the next era of financial, creative, and personal freedom by providing trusted access to the decentralized future. We envision a world where crypto reshapes the global financial system, internet, and money to create greater choice, independence, and opportunity for all — bridging traditional finance with the emerging cryptoeconomy in a way that is more open, fair, and secure. As a publicly traded company, Gemini is poised to accelerate this vision with greater scale, reach, and impact.

The Department: Platform Security

In the emerging industry of digital assets, there is nothing more important than trust. The Gemini security team forms the backbone of trust. In fact, Gemini’s very first hires were security specialists and we continue to tackle unique challenges in the crypto space. Our team ensures that our customers, clients, and employees are safe, secure, and supported.

The Role: Senior Manager, Platform Security

Gemini takes a cloud-first approach to our services, platforms, and vendors, allowing the organization to continue scaling with hypergrowth hiring, innovative product development, and demanding customer needs. To achieve that scale securely, Gemini has a dedicated Platform Security team whose mission is to enable the business to achieve secure-by-design architectures, implement best-in-class security technologies, and help our engineering partners to achieve security success easily & confidently. To further that mission, we’re looking for a new leader to join the existing team to take our vision, strategy, internal partnerships, business alignment, & technical expertise to the next stage of maturity. At Gemini, our best leaders lead from the trenches — we need this Senior Manager to remain hands-on, spending a meaningful portion of their time in the code, IaC, and architecture diagrams alongside their team — writing Terraform, reviewing PRs, and prototyping solutions, not just unblocking others when they're stuck.

Responsibilities:

Provide strategic and technical leadership of Gemini's Platform Security team, personally architecting and implementing security solutions alongside engineers — including writing and reviewing Terraform, CI/CD pipelines, and security tooling code
Align team-wide strategy with the needs of the business, internal partners, & peer Security leadership
Enable the ongoing success & growth of the team through creation of hiring plans and hands-on technical mentorship — pairing with engineers, reviewing designs and PRs, and staying current on the team's actual codebase
Establish a Platform Security roadmap for initiatives that will provide ever-increasing maturity of capabilities for stakeholders, while also reducing toil through automation
Serve as a senior technical escalation point for the team's hardest architecture and engineering problems, contributing working code/IaC when the situation calls for it
Foster trust-centric relationships with key partner teams, ensuring that their voices are heard and needs are being met, while achieving excellent security outcomes together
Lead the development of security policies, procedures, standards, & guidelines that will guide functional security outcomes with all GRC and Audits needs being met
Determine program KPIs that will meaningfully highlight where we’re succeeding, or falling short of, the mission we aim to accomplish for the business
Provide guidance through lived-experience and industry awareness on the different approaches to architecture, security engineering, and business-achievement goals
Define a customer-first process, choosing to provide self-service solutions that minimize friction, create agility, and provide value-oriented ways to solve problems
Manage relevant third-party vendor relationships, leading the determination of when & why to “build” vs. “buy” in response to gaps in capabilities the business may have

Qualifications:

5+ years of leadership experience for cloud-native engineering and/or security teams, with a strong preference for Amazon Web Services (AWS)-based organizations
10+ years of direct, technical experience in relevant roles (e.g., Platform Engineering, Security), with continued hands-on coding/IaC work within the last 2-3 years — not solely past practitioner experience
Strong experience in AWS, EKS (Kubernetes), IAM, Terraform, GitHub Enterprise Cloud
Experience leveraging industry security frameworks & standards that act as the basis of maturing the overall security program and enable successful business outcomes
Comfortable with hiring & scaling a team
Prior success in leading a team through organizational change management, with a strong preference for start-up experience in a technology-centric business
Able to easily communicate with technical stakeholders at their level, hearing their feedback and translating those needs or concerns into program-level outcomes
Pragmatic about security requirements, ignoring “best practices” that don’t make sense to the needs of the business by leveraging your team’s expertise for decision making
Strong written and verbal communication skills with an attention to detail

It Pays to Work Here

The compensation & benefits package for this role includes:

Competitive starting pay
A discretionary annual bonus
Long-term incentive in the form of a new hire equity grant
Comprehensive health plans
401K with company matching
Paid Parental Leave
Flexible time off

Salary Range
: The base salary range for this role is between $195,000 - $300,000 in the State of New York. This range is not inclusive of our discretionary bonus or equity package. When determining a candidate’s compensation, we consider a number of factors including skillset, experience, job scope, and current market data.

In the United States, we offer a hybrid work approach at our hub offices, balancing the benefits of in-person collaboration with the flexibility of remote work. Expectations may vary by location and role, so candidates are encouraged to connect with their recruiter to learn more about the specific policy for the role. Employees who do not live near one of our hubs are part of our remote workforce. All employees, however, are required to onboard in-person at one of our office locations.

new_jobs.description:
Position Summary...

What you'll do...Role summary:

Lead the strategy, roadmap, and execution of Walmart Marketplace's global pre-purchase delivery experience portfolio. As a Senior Manager, you will define long-term business strategy, influence executive decision-making, and lead cross-functional teams to build scalable delivery promise and speed capabilities that improve seller success and customer confidence. You will partner with Product, Engineering, Operations, Data Science, Finance, and external logistics providers to solve complex business challenges, accelerate global Marketplace growth, and deliver innovative pre-purchase capabilities that strengthen Walmart's competitive advantage.

About the team:

Marketplace Seller Fulfillment Solutions (SFS) provides customers a broad assortment of selection from third party sellers who fulfill on their own. Our team is comprised of motivated professionals who look for opportunities to create the best possible customer and seller experiences. SFS spans across multiple functional areas to achieve this excellence including pre purchase, post purchase, and returns.

What you'll do:

Own the strategy, roadmap, and business outcomes for global pre-purchase delivery experience initiatives, including delivery promise, expedited delivery, and speed programs.
Lead complex cross-functional programs by aligning business, product, engineering, operations, and data science teams around shared objectives.
Develop scalable capabilities that improve delivery transparency, customer confidence, seller performance, and Marketplace growth.
Leverage data, market insights, and financial analysis to prioritize investments, manage risk, and influence executive decisions.
Build organizational alignment and operational rigor to successfully deliver complex, multi-quarter initiatives.

What you'll bring:

Proven experience leading large-scale, cross-functional initiatives in eCommerce, customer experience, transportation, logistics, or supply chain.
Strong strategic leadership with the ability to translate vision into measurable business outcomes.
Exceptional executive communication and stakeholder management skills, with experience influencing senior leadership.
Deep analytical and financial acumen with a track record of using data to shape strategy and investment decisions.
Demonstrated success operating in ambiguous environments, balancing competing priorities, and delivering results through influence rather than direct authority.

At Walmart, we offer competitive pay as well as performance-based bonus awards and other great benefits for a happier mind, body, and wallet. Health benefits include medical, vision and dental coverage. Financial benefits include 401(k), stock purchase and company-paid life insurance. new_jobs.title: Director, Technology Solutions
new_jobs.description:
Become a part of our caring community

This position provides architecture leadership for CenterWell programs and platforms, shaping conceptual and reference architectures, governing solution designs, and aligning delivery teams to cloud and data strategies. The scope includes high-priority initiatives as well as interoperability and provider-data integrations that span CenterWell and Humana Insurance.

You will operate within CenterWell IT – Cross-CenterWell Architecture, collaborating with product, engineering, EA, security, data, and operations, and engaging governance forums to enable Integrated Health across CenterWell and Humana Insurance.

The Director, Technology Solutions acts as a liaison and collaborates with the business and functional stakeholders to identify and deliver strategic enablement solutions. Decisions are typically related to the implementation of new/updated programs or large-scale projects for the function and supporting technical/operational procedures and processes, and implements strategic plans, drives goals and objectives, and improves performance.

Key Activities

Quickly conduct structured knowledge transfer with existing architects and relevant stakeholders to capture critical in-flight designs and decisions.
Review current initiatives and establish an architectural roadmap aligned with organizational priorities.
Develop or refine reference architectures and design patterns for core platforms and solutions.
Collaborate with governance and compliance teams to validate designs against enterprise standards and regulatory requirements.
Define integration strategies and solution blueprints for key systems and data flows.
Establish architecture review processes and decision forums to support delivery readiness and quality assurance.

Core Responsibilities

Architectural Leadership: Own end-to-end solution architecture for Home Health initiatives, translating business outcomes into composable designs across systems of experience, operations, and insight.
Reference Architectures & Patterns: Author and maintain reference architectures for data platform, clinical documents NLP, RPA/automation, and interoperability patterns; steward pattern reuse across CenterWell when applicable.
Governance & Compliance: Lead architecture checkpoints and risk reviews; ensure designs conform to enterprise guardrails and privacy/security requirements. Participate in governance forums (e.g., ARB, TRB, MOR).
Delivery Enablement: Partner with product and engineering to convert conceptual designs into executable architectural runways; de-risk delivery with measurable non-functional requirements (NFRs).
Data & Integration Strategy: Define integration contracts and domain boundaries for provider data, EMR, and Snowflake/Databricks/Azure data platforms; ensure observability, lineage, and data protection.
Stakeholder Engagement: Collaborate with CenterWell leaders, EA Activation, security, and segment CIO teams; communicate decisions clearly to executives and delivery teams.

Required Qualifications

Use your skills to make an impact

Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or a related field.
8 years of progressive information technology experience directly related to architecture/engineering, information security, or other specialized technology field.
5+ years of solution architecture experience with healthcare delivery or payer/provider ecosystems; proven delivery within regulated environments (HIPAA/PHI).
Hands-on architecture across Azure services and Snowflake/Databricks (data lake/data platform patterns, data sharing, identity & access, vault/secrets management).
Demonstrated leadership producing reference architectures and governing solution designs across multiple teams.
Strong competency in APIs/event-driven integration, security models, and NFRs (availability, performance, resilience).
Generative & Agentic AI, Multi-Cloud - A seasoned Solutions Architect with hands-on experience delivering generative and agentic AI on Google Cloud, Azure, and AWS—leveraging services like Vertex AI, Azure OpenAI, and Amazon Bedrock—to implement production-grade capabilities including RAG, fine-tuning, prompt/knowledge management, and secure data integrations.
Demonstrated depth in:
Agent orchestration (tools/function calling, planning, memory, multi-agent collaboration)
Enterprise guardrails (security, compliance, responsible AI)
Robust MLOps/LLMOps practices for observability, evaluation, and cost/performance optimization
Proven ability to integrate AI systems with event-driven microservices, vector databases/feature stores, and CI/CD pipelines, while leading reference architectures and cross-cloud patterns that scale reliably.
Executive-level communication and stakeholder management across product, engineering, and enterprise functions.

Scheduled Weekly Hours

40

Pay Range

The compensation range below reflects a good faith estimate of starting base pay for full time (40 hours per week) employment at the time of posting. The pay range may be higher or lower based on geographic location and individual pay will vary based on demonstrated job related skills, knowledge, experience, education, certifications, etc.

$172,200 - $236,900 per year

This job is eligible for a bonus incentive plan. This incentive opportunity is based upon company and/or individual performance.

Description Of Benefits

Humana, Inc. and its affiliated subsidiaries (collectively, “Humana”) offers competitive benefits that support whole-person well-being. Associate benefits are designed to encourage personal wellness and smart healthcare decisions for you and your family while also knowing your life extends outside of work. Among our benefits, Humana provides medical, dental and vision benefits, 401(k) retirement savings plan, time off (including paid time off, company and personal holidays, paid parental and caregiver leave), short-term and long-term disability, life insurance and many other opportunities.

About Us

About Humana: Humana Inc. (NYSE: HUM) is a leading U.S. healthcare company. Through our Humana insurance services and our CenterWell healthcare services, we make it easier for the millions of people we serve to achieve their best health – delivering the care and service they need, when they need it. These efforts are leading to a better quality of life for people with Medicare and Medicaid, families, individuals, military service personnel, and communities at large. Learn more about what we offer at Humana.com and at CenterWell.com.

Equal Opportunity Employer

It is the policy of Humana not to discriminate against any employee or applicant for employment because of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, marital status, genetic information, disability or protected veteran status. Partner with Product Management to translate business and customer needs into executable engineering plans.
Use AI to assist with product development and deployment of AI capabilities in our customer-facing solutions.
Establish and monitor KPIs and engineering metrics related to delivery, quality, reliability, and team health.

Engineering talent retention and growth
Alignment between engineering output and business outcomes
